33418.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Zombie — tugagan, lekin ota-jarayoni `wait()` qilib exit status'ini yig'magan jarayon (`<defunct>`). Container'da ilova PID 1 bo'ladi, PID 1 esa orphan jarayonlarni "asrab oladi" va ularni yig'ishi kerak. Oddiy ilova buni qilmaydi — zombie'lar to'planadi. `tini` / `docker run --init` — kichik init: zombie'larni yig'adi va signallarni ilovaga uzatadi.

**Muammo:**
- PID 1 uchun kernel default signal handler qo'ymaydi — ilova SIGTERM'ni o'zi ushlamasa, `docker stop` 10s kutib SIGKILL beradi.
- Shell script, Node/Python child process, headless Chrome — orphan'lar PID 1'ga o'tadi; yig'ilmasa PID limit tugaydi: `fork: Resource temporarily unavailable`.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
tini'siz:   PID1 app -- child (tugadi) -> <defunct> qoladi
tini bilan: PID1 tini -- PID2 app -- child (tugadi) -> tini wait() qiladi
            SIGTERM -> tini -> app
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker run --init myimage                   # Docker o'zi docker-init (tini) qo'shadi
docker exec <id> ps -ef | grep defunct      # zombie bormi
```
```dockerfile
RUN apk add --no-cache tini
ENTRYPOINT ["/sbin/tini", "--"]
CMD ["/app"]
```
Compose: `init: true`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `ENTRYPOINT ["sh","-c","/app"]` — sh PID 1, signal ham, zombie ham muammo.
- tini qo'shib, ilovada SIGTERM handler yozmaslik — signal yetadi, lekin graceful shutdown baribir yo'q.
- Kubernetes'da `shareProcessNamespace: true` bo'lsa pause container PID 1 bo'lib zombie'larni yig'adi; aks holda muammo o'sha.

**Senior nuqta:** Child ochmaydigan va SIGTERM'ni ushlaydigan Go binary'ga tini shart emas. Lekin entrypoint script yoki subprocess ishlatadigan har qanday image'da `--init` arzon sug'urta.

33419.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `/var/run/docker.sock` — Docker API. Unga kirishi bor container istalgan container'ni istalgan parametr bilan yarata oladi, masalan host'ning `/` papkasini mount qilib — bu amalda host root. `--privileged` esa barcha capability'larni beradi, `/dev` ni ochadi va seccomp/AppArmor'ni o'chiradi — container'dan host'ga chiqish bir necha buyruq.

**Muammo:** CI agent yoki monitoring tool "qulaylik uchun" docker.sock bilan ishga tushirilgan. Undagi zaiflik yoki zararli dependency butun host'ni egallaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
container (docker.sock mount) -> docker API -> yangi container:
   -v /:/host --privileged -> chroot /host -> host root shell
```

**Amalda (hujum ko'rinishi, faqat test muhitda):**
```bash
docker run -it -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock docker:cli sh
# ichida:
docker run -it --rm -v /:/host alpine chroot /host sh    # host root
```
Tekshirish:
```bash
docker ps -q | xargs docker inspect --format '{{.Name}} priv={{.HostConfig.Privileged}} {{range .Mounts}}{{.Source}} {{end}}' | grep -E 'priv=true|docker.sock'
```

| Narsa | Nima beradi | Alternativa |
|---|---|---|
| `docker.sock` mount | host root | CI: BuildKit rootless / Buildah; monitoring: read-only socket proxy |
| `--privileged` | barcha capability, `/dev` | `--cap-add NET_ADMIN` (faqat kerakli) |
| `--pid=host`, `--network=host` | host jarayon/tarmoq | kerak bo'lsa alohida node |
| `hostPath: /` (K8s) | host FS | PVC, ConfigMap |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Socket'ni `:ro` mount qilish himoya qilmaydi — API so'rovlari baribir ishlaydi.
- `docker` guruhiga user qo'shish ham = root huquqi.
- "Faqat ichki tool" deb privileged qoldirish — supply chain hujumi aynan shu yerga tushadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Kubernetes'da Pod Security Admission `baseline`/`restricted` privileged va hostPath'ni bloklaydi; Kyverno/Gatekeeper bilan qo'shimcha siyosat. Socket kerak bo'lsa — `tecnativa/docker-socket-proxy` kabi faqat kerakli endpoint'larni ochadigan proxy.

33420.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kubernetes runner'da Docker daemon yo'q (va DinD privileged talab qiladi). Daemon'siz builder'lar ishlatiladi: **BuildKit** (rootless rejimda), **Buildah**/Podman, ilgari **Kaniko**. Ular Dockerfile'ni o'qib, image'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri registry'ga push qiladi.

**Muammo:** CI pod'ida `docker build` — "Cannot connect to the Docker daemon". DinD (`docker:dind`) ishlatish uchun `privileged: true` kerak — bu node'ni xavf ostiga qo'yadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
CI pod (privileged yo'q)
  buildkitd/buildah (rootless, user namespace)
     Dockerfile -> layer'lar -> registry push
     cache <-> registry (type=registry)
```

**Amalda (BuildKit rootless):**
```yaml
# GitLab CI
build:
  image: moby/buildkit:rootless
  variables:
    BUILDKITD_FLAGS: --oci-worker-no-process-sandbox
  script:
    - buildctl-daemonless.sh build
        --frontend dockerfile.v0
        --local context=. --local dockerfile=.
        --output type=image,name=$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA,push=true
        --export-cache type=registry,ref=$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:cache
        --import-cache type=registry,ref=$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:cache
```
Buildah:
```bash
buildah bud -t registry/app:$SHA . && buildah push registry/app:$SHA
```

| Vosita | Xususiyat |
|---|---|
| DinD | oddiy, lekin privileged |
| Kaniko | daemon'siz; 2025 da upstream arxivlangan (Chainguard fork bor) |
| BuildKit rootless | tez, cache mount, multi-arch |
| Buildah / Podman | daemon'siz, rootless, Red Hat ekotizimi |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Rootless BuildKit ham ba'zi kernel sozlamalarini talab qiladi (user namespace, seccomp/AppArmor unconfined).
- Remote cache'siz har build noldan — juda sekin.
- Registry credential'ni image'ga yoki log'ga chiqarib yuborish.

**Senior nuqta:** Yangi loyihada Kaniko emas, BuildKit (yoki boshqariladigan builder: Docker Build Cloud, GitHub hosted runner). Build pod'larini alohida node pool'da izolyatsiya qiling.

33421.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Image layer'lari OverlayFS'da read-only `lowerdir` sifatida ustma-ust qo'yiladi, container'ga esa yozish uchun `upperdir` beriladi. Container faylni o'zgartirsa, fayl avval upper layer'ga to'liq nusxalanadi (copy-on-write), keyin o'zgartiriladi.

**Nega bilish kerak:** Image hajmi, disk tejash, I/O tezligi va "nega rm qilsam ham image kichraymadi" kabi savollarning javobi shu mexanizmda.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
 merged (container ko'radigan /)
   ^
 upperdir  container layer (RW)   <- yozish va whiteout shu yerga
 ---------------------------------
 layer 3: COPY app        (RO)
 layer 2: RUN apk add     (RO)    lowerdir
 layer 1: alpine base     (RO)
```
Fayl o'chirilsa — pastki layer'dan o'chmaydi, upper'da "whiteout" belgisi yoziladi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker run -d --name t alpine sleep 1d
docker exec t sh -c 'echo hi > /root/x; rm /etc/motd'
docker diff t
# A /root/x     (added)
# D /etc/motd   (deleted - whiteout)
docker inspect t --format '{{json .GraphDriver.Data}}' | jq
# LowerDir, UpperDir, MergedDir yo'llari
```

**Oqibatlar:**
- 10 container bitta image'dan — layer'lar diskda bir marta.
- 1 GB faylga 1 bayt yozish — avval 1 GB nusxalanadi (sekin).
- `RUN rm big.tar` keyingi layer'da — image kichraymaydi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- DB ma'lumotini container layer'ida saqlash — CoW sekin va `rm` da yo'qoladi. Volume ishlating.
- `RUN wget x.tar && ...` va `RUN rm x.tar` ni alohida qatorda yozish.
- Secret'ni COPY qilib keyin o'chirish — oldingi layer'da qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Yozish ko'p bo'lgan papkalar (log, cache, data) har doim volume yoki tmpfs'da bo'lsin — bu ham tezlik, ham `--read-only` rootfs'ga yo'l ochadi.

33422.a:
```sh
kubectl get pod api-0 -o jsonpath='{.metadata.finalizers}'
kubectl describe pod api-0          # Events: volume detach?
kubectl get node <node>             # NotReady?
```

| Sabab | Yechim |
|---|---|
| Node NotReady / o'chgan | Node'ni tiklash yoki `kubectl delete node` |
| Finalizer (controller ishlamayapti) | Controller'ni tuzatish; oxirgi chora — finalizer'ni patch bilan olib tashlash |
| Volume detach osildi (EBS) | CSI driver log'lari, cloud console |
| App SIGTERM'ni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi | Grace period tugagach o'zi o'ladi |

```sh
kubectl delete pod api-0 --grace-period=0 --force
```
**Ogohlantirish:** force delete faqat API'dan o'chiradi; container node'da hali ishlashi mumkin. StatefulSet'da bir xil identitetli ikkinchi pod paydo bo'lib, bir diskka ikkalasi yozishi mumkin.

33423.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Exit code 128+N = signal N bilan o'ldirilgan. **143** = 128+15 (**SIGTERM**) — jarayon to'xtatish so'rovi bilan tugadi (odatda normal: pod o'chirilishi, rollout, scale down, eviction). **137** = 128+9 (**SIGKILL**) — majburan o'ldirildi: OOMKilled, grace period tugadi, yoki liveness muvaffaqiyatsiz.

**Nega farqi muhim:** 143 ko'pincha "ilova SIGTERM'ni o'zi ushlamadi, default handler bilan chiqdi" — xato emas, lekin graceful shutdown yo'qligini ko'rsatishi mumkin. 137 esa — doim tekshirish kerak bo'lgan signal.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
pod o'chirish -> SIGTERM -> ilova:
   handler bor, tozaladi, exit 0       -> Completed / 0
   handler yo'q (default)              -> 143
   grace period ichida chiqmadi        -> SIGKILL -> 137
memory limit oshdi -> kernel SIGKILL   -> 137 + reason OOMKilled
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl get pod api-x -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState.terminated}'
# {"exitCode":137,"reason":"OOMKilled",...}  yoki {"exitCode":143,"reason":"Error"}
kubectl describe pod api-x | grep -E "Reason|Exit Code|Liveness"
kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=api-x
```
| Kod | Signal | Tipik sabab |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | - | toza chiqish |
| 1 | - | ilova xatosi |
| 137 | SIGKILL | OOM, grace tugadi, liveness |
| 139 | SIGSEGV | segfault (native kod) |
| 143 | SIGTERM | to'xtatish |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- 137 + reason `Error` (OOMKilled emas) — grace period yetmagan yoki liveness; event'larni qarang.
- PID 1 muammosi: shell skript PID 1 bo'lsa SIGTERM'ni bolaga uzatmaydi — `exec` yoki `tini`.
- Job'da 143 — `activeDeadlineSeconds` tugagani bo'lishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Ilovalar SIGTERM'da 0 bilan chiqishi kerak — shunda 143/137 lar haqiqiy anomaliya signali bo'ladi va alert'lar shovqinsiz ishlaydi.

33424.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `ndots:5` (K8s default) degani: nomda 5 tadan kam nuqta bo'lsa, resolver avval uni **search domain'lar** bilan qo'shib sinaydi. `api.stripe.com` (2 nuqta) uchun avval `api.stripe.com.prod.svc.cluster.local`, `...svc.cluster.local`, `...cluster.local` (+ node search domain'lari) — har biri NXDOMAIN — keyingina haqiqiy nom. Har birida A va AAAA so'rov: bitta tashqi so'rov 8-10 DNS so'roviga aylanadi.

**Muammo:** tashqi API chaqiruvlari latency'sida qo'shimcha 20-100ms, CoreDNS CPU'si yuqori, ba'zan conntrack race tufayli 5 soniyalik DNS timeout'lar.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
/etc/resolv.conf:
  search prod.svc.cluster.local svc.cluster.local cluster.local
  options ndots:5
"api.stripe.com" -> 2 nuqta < 5 -> search ro'yxati bo'ylab:
  api.stripe.com.prod.svc.cluster.local   NXDOMAIN
  api.stripe.com.svc.cluster.local        NXDOMAIN
  api.stripe.com.cluster.local            NXDOMAIN
  api.stripe.com.                         OK
"api.stripe.com." (oxirida nuqta) -> FQDN, darhol
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl exec api-x -- cat /etc/resolv.conf
kubectl run d --rm -it --image=nicolaka/netshoot -- bash
  tcpdump -ni any port 53 &      # keyin: curl -s https://api.stripe.com > /dev/null
```
```yaml
spec:
  dnsConfig:
    options:
    - { name: ndots, value: "2" }
```
Yechimlar: tashqi nomlarni FQDN (oxirida nuqta) bilan yozish; `ndots` ni 1-2 ga tushirish; NodeLocal DNSCache (har node'da kesh, conntrack muammosini ham kamaytiradi); CoreDNS `autopath` plugin'i.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `ndots: 1` qilsangiz `db.prod` kabi qisqa cluster nomlari ishlamay qolishi mumkin — ilova to'liq nom ishlatadimi, tekshiring.
- Alpine (musl) resolver'i glibc'dan farqli ishlaydi (parallel so'rovlar, search xulqi) — ba'zi xatolar faqat Alpine'da.
- Muammo DNS'da ekanini isbotlamay turib `ndots` o'zgartirish — avval o'lchang.

**Senior nuqta:** DNS — eng ko'p yashiringan latency manbai. CoreDNS metrikalari (`coredns_dns_requests_total` rcode NXDOMAIN ulushi) yuqori bo'lsa — ndots muammosining aniq belgisi; NodeLocal DNSCache katta cluster'da standart bo'lishi kerak.

33425.a:
**Qisqa javob:** cert-manager — K8s operator'i: `Certificate` resursiga qarab CA'dan (Let's Encrypt ACME, Vault, private CA) sertifikat oladi, uni Secret'ga yozadi va muddati tugashidan oldin (default 2/3 umrida) avtomatik yangilaydi. Ingress'ga annotation (`cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer`) qo'shilsa, sertifikatni o'zi yaratadi.

**Muammo:** sertifikat muddati tugadi, sayt "Your connection is not private" ko'rsatdi — eng ko'p uchraydigan va eng uyatli outage. Qo'lda yangilash unutiladi; Let's Encrypt sertifikatlari 90 kun (va qisqarib bormoqda) — avtomatlashtirish majburiy.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Ingress (tls.secretName: shop-tls, annotation issuer=letsencrypt)
   -> cert-manager: Certificate -> CertificateRequest -> Order -> Challenge
   -> ACME HTTP-01: /.well-known/acme-challenge/<token> ni vaqtinchalik ingress orqali ko'rsatadi
      yoki DNS-01: _acme-challenge TXT record (wildcard uchun shart)
   -> Let's Encrypt tekshiradi -> sertifikat -> Secret shop-tls
   -> ingress controller Secret'ni o'qib TLS beradi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: ClusterIssuer
metadata: { name: letsencrypt }
spec:
  acme:
    server: https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory
    email: ops@example.com
    privateKeySecretRef: { name: le-account }
    solvers:
    - http01: { ingress: { ingressClassName: nginx } }
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: shop
  annotations: { cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: letsencrypt }
spec:
  tls: [{ hosts: [shop.example.com], secretName: shop-tls }]
  rules: [...]
```
```bash
kubectl get certificate -A          # READY True, muddati
kubectl describe certificate shop-tls
kubectl get challenges -A           # osilib qolgan challenge -> sabab
cmctl status certificate shop-tls
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Test paytida prod ACME'ga ko'p so'rov — rate limit; avval `letsencrypt-staging`.
- HTTP-01 uchun 80-port tashqaridan ochiq va DNS cluster LB'ga ko'rsatishi kerak.
- DNS-01 uchun DNS provider credential'i — minimal huquq (faqat kerakli zona, faqat TXT), workload identity bilan.
- Private key Secret'da — RBAC bilan himoyalang.

**Senior nuqta:** Avtomatik yangilanishga ishonmang, tekshiring: `certmanager_certificate_expiration_timestamp_seconds` bo'yicha "14 kundan kam qoldi" alert'i va tashqi blackbox probe (`probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry`). Yangilanish mexanizmi buzilsa ham vaqtida bilasiz.

33426.a:
**Qisqa javob:** ConfigMap volume'i odatda symlink orqali atomik yangilanadi (`..data` -> yangi papka). `subPath` esa bitta faylni **bind mount** qiladi va pod yaratilgan paytdagi aniq fayl inode'iga bog'lanadi — kubelet keyin symlink'ni almashtirsa ham, subPath eski faylga qarab qoladi. Shuning uchun subPath mount hech qachon yangilanmaydi.

**Muammo:** `nginx.conf`ni `/etc/nginx/nginx.conf` ga subPath bilan mount qildingiz (papkaning boshqa fayllarini yo'qotmaslik uchun). ConfigMap o'zgardi, nginx eski konfig bilan ishlayapti, hech qanday xato yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Oddiy volume mount (/etc/app):
  /etc/app/app.yaml -> ..data/app.yaml
  ..data -> ..2026_10_03_10_00 (eski)  ==sync==>  ..2026_10_03_11_00 (yangi)  atomik
subPath mount:
  /etc/nginx/nginx.conf  ==bind==> aniq fayl (eski inode) -- yangilanmaydi
```

**Amalda (yechimlar):**
```yaml
# 1) Butun papkani boshqa joyga mount + ilova shu yo'ldan o'qisin
volumeMounts:
- { name: cfg, mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d }
# 2) subPath qolsa — config o'zgarganda pod'larni qayta yaratish:
#    Helm: annotation checksum/config, Kustomize: configMapGenerator (nomga hash)
template:
  metadata:
    annotations:
      checksum/config: {{ include (print $.Template.BasePath "/cm.yaml") . | sha256sum }}
```
```bash
kubectl exec web-x -- cat /etc/nginx/nginx.conf   # eski
kubectl rollout restart deploy/web                # majburiy yangilash
kubectl exec web-x -- ls -la /etc/app             # ..data symlink'ni ko'rish
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Oddiy mount ham darhol emas — kubelet sync davri + cache (~1 daqiqagacha).
- Fayl yangilansa ham ilova uni qayta o'qimasa — reload kerak (nginx `-s reload`, inotify, sidecar reloader).
- Env orqali berilgan qiymatlar ham yangilanmaydi.
- Secret'lar uchun ham aynan shu qoida.

**Senior nuqta:** "Jonli" config yangilanishi kuzatib bo'lmaydigan o'zgarish yaratadi. Ko'p jamoalar ataylab immutable ConfigMap + rollout yo'lini tanlaydi: har o'zgarish yangi revision, sinovdan o'tadi va rollback qilinadi.

33427.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `Exact` — yo'l aynan mos kelishi kerak (`/api` faqat `/api`). `Prefix` — `/` bilan bo'lingan element bo'yicha prefiks (`/api` -> `/api`, `/api/users`, lekin `/apiv2` emas). `ImplementationSpecific` — ma'nosi Ingress controller'ga bog'liq (nginx'da regex ham bo'lishi mumkin).

**Muammo:** `/api` Prefix qo'yildi, `/apidocs` frontend'ga ketishi kerak edi — controller'ga qarab har xil ishladi, chunki `ImplementationSpecific` ishlatilgan edi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
so'rov /api/users
  Exact /api            -> mos emas
  Prefix /api           -> mos (element: api)
  Prefix /ap            -> mos emas (element butun bo'lishi kerak)
Bir nechta mos kelsa: eng uzun yo'l, teng bo'lsa Exact > Prefix
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata: { name: shop }
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  rules:
  - host: shop.example.com
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /healthz
        pathType: Exact
        backend: { service: { name: api, port: { number: 8080 } } }
      - path: /api
        pathType: Prefix
        backend: { service: { name: api, port: { number: 8080 } } }
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend: { service: { name: web, port: { number: 80 } } }
```
```bash
curl -sI https://shop.example.com/api/users   # api
curl -sI https://shop.example.com/apix        # web (/ ga tushadi)
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Trailing slash: `Prefix /api/` va `/api` bir xil hisoblanadi, lekin `Exact`'da farq qiladi.
- ingress-nginx'da `use-regex` + `rewrite-target` — `ImplementationSpecific` kerak; portativ emas.
- 2025-2026: ingress-nginx loyihasi rasmiy ravishda to'xtatilish (retirement) jarayonida — yangi loyihalar Gateway API (`HTTPRoute`)ga qarasin.

**Senior nuqta:** Portativlik uchun faqat `Exact` va `Prefix` ishlating; murakkab marshrutlash (header, weight, rewrite) kerak bo'lsa Gateway API — u standartlashtirilgan va controller'lar orasida bir xil ma'noga ega.

33428.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Client-side apply (CSA) — `kubectl` diff'ni o'zi hisoblaydi va `last-applied-configuration` annotation'ga tayanadi. Server-Side Apply (SSA) — hisob apiserver'da, har maydonning **egasi** (field manager) `managedFields`'da yoziladi; boshqa egadagi maydonni o'zgartirmoqchi bo'lsangiz **conflict** chiqadi.

**Muammo:** CI `replicas: 3` apply qiladi, HPA uni 8 ga o'zgartiradi, keyingi apply yana 3 qiladi. Yoki ikki controller bitta maydonni navbatma-navbat qayta yozadi — hech kim bilmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
managedFields:
  manager: kubectl   (Apply)    -> spec.template, spec.selector
  manager: hpa-controller       -> spec.replicas
Yangi apply spec.replicas ni o'zgartirmoqchi:
  SSA -> 409 Conflict ("conflict with hpa-controller")
  --force-conflicts -> egalikni oladi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl apply --server-side -f deploy.yaml --field-manager=ci
kubectl apply --server-side --force-conflicts -f deploy.yaml
kubectl get deploy api -o yaml --show-managed-fields | less
kubectl diff --server-side -f deploy.yaml
```
CSA -> SSA ko'chishda birinchi `--server-side` apply eski annotation'dan egalikni o'zlashtiradi.

| | CSA | SSA |
|---|---|---|
| Diff joyi | kubectl | apiserver |
| Holat | annotation (256KB limit) | managedFields |
| Conflict | jim qayta yozish | aniq xato |
| Katta CRD | annotation limitiga uriladi | muammo yo'q |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Har doim `--force-conflicts` ishlatish SSA ma'nosini yo'q qiladi.
- Manifestda `replicas` qoldirish + HPA = doimiy conflict; maydonni olib tashlang.
- Katta CRD'lar (masalan Prometheus Operator CRD) CSA'da "metadata.annotations: Too long" xatosini beradi — SSA yechimi.

**Senior nuqta:** SSA controller'lar va GitOps uchun standart (Argo CD `ServerSideApply=true`, Flux default). Field ownership — "kim nimaga egalik qiladi" savolini kodlashtiradi; bu ko'p aktorli platformada drift va urushlarni yo'q qiladi.

33429.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `kubectl get events` — cluster'dagi qisqa muddatli hodisalar jurnali: scheduling (FailedScheduling), image pull, probe xatolari, OOM, eviction, volume attach, scale. Event'lar default ~1 soat saqlanadi. Debug'da "nima bo'ldi va qaysi tartibda" savoliga birinchi javob.

**Muammo:** pod Pending yoki restart bo'lyapti, log'da hech narsa yo'q — chunki muammo ilovada emas, platformada (scheduler, kubelet, CSI). Platforma o'z xabarlarini event'larga yozadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
scheduler, kubelet, controller'lar -> Event obyekti (type Normal/Warning, reason, message, count)
   -> etcd (TTL ~1h) -> kubectl get events
`describe` pastidagi Events bo'limi = shu obyekt bo'yicha filtrlangan event'lar
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl get events -n prod --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -30
kubectl get events -A --field-selector type=Warning
kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=api-x
kubectl events -n prod --for pod/api-x --watch        # yangi `kubectl events` buyrug'i
kubectl get events -A --field-selector reason=FailedScheduling
```
O'qish: `REASON` ustuni kalit — `FailedScheduling`, `BackOff`, `Unhealthy`, `FailedMount`, `Evicted`, `OOMKilling`; `COUNT` katta bo'lsa muammo takrorlanyapti.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Event'lar 1 soatda yo'qoladi — kechagi incident'ni event'lardan topib bo'lmaydi. Eksport qiling (kubernetes-event-exporter, Grafana Alloy) Loki/Elastic'ga.
- Default `get events` vaqt bo'yicha saralanmagan — `--sort-by` ishlating.
- Event'lar kafolatlangan yetkazilish emas (best effort), ba'zilari birlashtiriladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Warning event'larni markaziy log tizimiga oqizish va `reason` bo'yicha dashboard/alert qilish (masalan FailedScheduling soni o'sishi = sig'im tugayapti) — arzon, lekin kuchli platforma signali.

33430.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Helm hook — chart'dagi resurs (odatda Job) ni release hayot siklining ma'lum nuqtasida (`pre-install`, `pre-upgrade`, `post-upgrade`) ishga tushirish. DB migratsiyani `pre-upgrade` hook bilan qilish xavfli, chunki `helm rollback` sxemani qaytarmaydi va migratsiya o'rtada yiqilsa release yarim holatda qoladi.

**Muammo:** "Yangi kod ishga tushishdan oldin migratsiya bo'lsin" uchun `pre-upgrade` Job yoziladi. Lekin rollback paytida yangi ustunlar/jadvallar qoladi — eski kod ular bilan ishlamaydi yoki yiqiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: migrate-{{ .Release.Revision }}
  annotations:
    "helm.sh/hook": pre-upgrade,pre-install
    "helm.sh/hook-weight": "0"
    "helm.sh/hook-delete-policy": before-hook-creation,hook-succeeded
spec:
  backoffLimit: 1
  activeDeadlineSeconds: 600
```

**Xavflar va qoidalar:**
- `helm rollback` sxemani qaytarmaydi — migratsiya **backward-compatible** (expand/contract) bo'lsin.
- `activeDeadlineSeconds` yo'q bo'lsa osilgan Job release'ni `pending-upgrade` holatida qoldiradi.
- Hook resurslari release tarkibida kuzatilmaydi — `hook-delete-policy` bilan tozalash kerak.
- ArgoCD Helm hook'larini o'z sync hook'lariga (`PreSync`) map qiladi — `helm install/upgrade` bajarmaydi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Non-idempotent migratsiya qayta ishga tushsa (retry) ikki marta qo'llanadi.
- Hook Job fail bo'lsa upgrade to'xtaydi, lekin yangi pod'lar allaqachon chiqqan bo'lishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Migratsiyani Helm hook'ga bog'lamaslik yaxshiroq — alohida, idempotent, backward-compatible qadam sifatida (expand → deploy → contract). Hook ishlatilsa ham sxema har doim eski kod bilan mos bo'lsin, aks holda rollback imkonsiz.

33431.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `Chart.lock` — chart dependency'larining aniq versiyalarini qotiradi (reproducible build), `values.schema.json` esa `values` ni deploy'dan oldin JSON Schema bilan tekshiradi (noto'g'ri tur/yetishmagan maydon — xato).

**Muammo:** `version: 20.x.x` har build'da boshqa minor versiyani olib kelishi mumkin — "menda ishladi" muammosi. Va `replicas: "3"` (string) yoki tag yetishmasligi faqat deploy paytida bilinadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```yaml
# Chart.yaml
dependencies:
  - name: redis
    version: 20.x.x
    repository: oci://registry-1.docker.io/bitnamicharts
    condition: redis.enabled
```
`helm dependency update` → `Chart.lock` (aniq versiya + digest) va `charts/*.tgz`. Lock **commit qilinadi**.
```json
// values.schema.json
{ "type": "object", "required": ["image"],
  "properties": {
    "replicas": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1 },
    "image": { "type": "object", "required": ["tag"],
               "properties": { "tag": { "type": "string" } } } } }
```

**Amalda:**
```sh
helm dependency update ./chart     # Chart.lock yangilaydi
helm dependency build ./chart      # lock bo'yicha aniq versiyani tortadi (CI)
helm lint ./chart                  # schema'ni ham tekshiradi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `Chart.lock` ni commit qilmaslik — reproducible emas; CI'da `dependency build` ishlat.
- Subchart values chart nomi ostida: `redis.auth.enabled` (ildizda emas).
- Schema faqat strukturani tekshiradi, mantiqni emas (masalan ikki o'zaro zid qiymat).

**Senior nuqta:** Lock + schema + `helm lint` CI gate — noto'g'ri konfig klaster'ga yetib bormasin. OCI registry'dan dependency + digest pin = supply chain integrity. Schema shuningdek yangi jamoa a'zosi uchun hujjat vazifasini bajaradi.

33432.a:
**Qisqa javob:** State buyruqlari state faylini to'g'ridan boshqaradi: `list` — boshqariladigan resurslar, `show` — bitta resurs atributlari, `mv` — manzilni o'zgartirish (resurs qayta yaratilmaydi), `rm` — resursni state'dan "unutish" (cloud'da qoladi). Bugun ko'p hollarda `moved {}`/`import {}`/`removed {}` bloklari afzal — ular kodda va review qilinadi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
terraform state list
terraform state list module.vpc
terraform state show aws_s3_bucket.logs
terraform state pull > backup-$(date +%F).tfstate    # AVVAL nusxa
terraform state mv aws_instance.web module.web.aws_instance.this
terraform state rm aws_s3_bucket.legacy    # bucket o'chmaydi, faqat unutiladi
```
Deklarativ muqobillar (1.7+):
```hcl
moved {
  from = aws_instance.web
  to   = module.web.aws_instance.this
}
removed {
  from = aws_s3_bucket.legacy
  lifecycle { destroy = false }     # state'dan chiqar, cloud'da qoldir
}
```

| Vazifa | Afzal usul |
|---|---|
| Rename / modulga ko'chirish | `moved {}` |
| Boshqa state'ga ko'chirish | `removed {}` (yoki `state rm`) + yangi joyda `import {}` |
| Qo'lda yaratilganni olish | `import {}` |
| Tekshirish | `state list/show` |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Backup'siz `state mv/rm` — xato bo'lsa tiklash qiyin (bucket versioning yordam beradi).
- `state rm` dan keyin kodda resurs qolsa — keyingi plan uni **yangidan yaratadi** (dublikat).
- Lokal state buyruqlari CI apply bilan bir vaqtda — lock to'qnashuvi yoki yo'qolgan yozuv.

**Senior nuqta:** Qo'lda state jarrohligi — favqulodda holat: ikki kishi ko'zi bilan, backup bilan, CI'dan tashqarida va hujjatlashtirib. Odatiy refactor'lar kod bloklari orqali.

33433.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Bu xato boshqa operatsiya (CI job yoki hamkasb) state lock'ini ushlab turganini bildiradi. `force-unlock` faqat lock egasi **haqiqatan ishlamayotganiga** (job tugagan, crash bo'lgan) ishonch hosil qilgandan keyin xavfsiz; aks holda ikki apply bir state'ga yozib, uni buzadi.

**O'qish:**
```
Error: Error acquiring the state lock
Lock Info:
  ID:        6f1c...e2
  Path:      acme-tfstate/prod/app.tfstate
  Operation: OperationTypeApply
  Who:       runner@ci-123
  Version:   1.10.3
  Created:   2026-10-02 09:14:03 UTC
```

**Tekshiruv tartibi:**
```
1. Who -> ci-123: shu job hali ishlayaptimi? (CI UI)
   yoki odam -> undan so'rang
2. Created -> qancha vaqt o'tdi? apply odatda necha daqiqa?
3. Job crash/cancel bo'lgan -> lock "osilib" qolgan
4. Ishonch bor -> force-unlock, keyin plan bilan state'ni tekshirish
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
terraform force-unlock 6f1c...e2
terraform plan          # state izchilmi, kutilmagan o'zgarish yo'qmi
terraform apply -lock-timeout=5m    # qisqa navbat uchun kutish
```
CI'da oldini olish:
```yaml
concurrency:
  group: tf-prod-app       # bir state'ga bitta job
  cancel-in-progress: false
timeout-minutes: 60
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Uzoq ishlayotgan (masalan, RDS yaratish 20 daqiqa) apply'ni "osilgan" deb unlock qilish.
- CI job'ni bekor qilish (cancel) — Terraform lock'ni bo'shatmay qolishi mumkin.
- Drift job yoki `console` ham lock oladi — read-only ishlar uchun `-lock=false`.

**Senior nuqta:** Tez-tez lock to'qnashuvi — arxitektura signali: state juda katta yoki ko'p yo'l bilan apply qilinadi. State'ni bo'ling va apply'ni bitta pipeline'ga to'plang.

33434.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `-target` — plan/apply'ni faqat ko'rsatilgan resurs (va uning bog'liqliklari) bilan cheklaydi. Anti-pattern, chunki u to'liq rasmni yashiradi: boshqa o'zgarishlar va drift ko'rinmaydi, state kod bilan nomuvofiq qoladi. Terraform o'zi "routine use not recommended" deb ogohlantiradi.

**Qanday xavf:**
```
kod: SG o'zgardi + LB o'zgardi + IAM o'zgardi
apply -target=SG  -> faqat SG
natija: LB va IAM kod bilan mos emas, keyingi to'liq plan kutilmagan diff ko'rsatadi
```

**Amalda (o'rinli holatlar):**
```bash
# incident: bitta SG qoidasini tez tuzatish
terraform plan -target=aws_security_group.api -out fix.plan
terraform apply fix.plan
terraform plan          # darhol keyin to'liq plan: nima qoldi?

# bootstrap: avval provider'ga kerak bo'lgan resurs (masalan, EKS cluster)
terraform apply -target=module.eks
terraform apply
```
```
Warning: Resource targeting is in effect
... routine use of this option is not recommended
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Har kuni `-target` — state'da kim nimani qachon qo'llagani noaniq.
- Target bog'liq resurslarni ham oladi — kutganingizdan ko'p narsa o'zgaradi.
- CI'da `-target` ishlatish — review qilingan plan to'liq bo'lmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Doim target kerak bo'lsa — state juda katta yoki bog'liqliklar noto'g'ri. State'ni (network / data / app) bo'ling yoki provider bootstrap muammosini ikki bosqichli konfiguratsiyaga ajrating.

33436.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Ikki yo'l: `terraform_remote_state` — boshqa jamoa state'ining output'larini o'qish; yoki data source / SSM parametr — tag yoki nom kontrakti bo'yicha resursni to'g'ridan topish. Kichik jamoada remote_state oddiy; jamoalar ko'p bo'lsa data source/SSM xavfsizroq, chunki remote_state butun state'ga (secret'lar bilan) o'qish ruxsatini talab qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
network jamoa: VPC -> output private_subnets -> state (S3)
                                  |                    \
app jamoa: terraform_remote_state (butun state o'qiladi)  \
   yoki:   data "aws_subnets" (tag: Tier=private)          SSM /net/prod/subnets
```

**Amalda:**
```hcl
# 1) remote state
data "terraform_remote_state" "net" {
  backend = "s3"
  config = {
    bucket = "tf-state"
    key    = "network/prod.tfstate"
    region = "eu-central-1"
  }
}
locals { subnet_id = data.terraform_remote_state.net.outputs.private_subnets[0] }

# 2) data source (tag kontrakti)
data "aws_subnets" "private" {
  filter {
    name   = "tag:Tier"
    values = ["private"]
  }
}

# 3) SSM parametr kontrakti (network jamoa yozadi)
data "aws_ssm_parameter" "subnets" { name = "/network/prod/private-subnets" }
locals { subnets = split(",", data.aws_ssm_parameter.subnets.value) }
```

| | remote_state | data source / SSM |
|---|---|---|
| Ruxsat | butun state (secret'lar ham) | faqat kerakli resurs/parametr |
| Bog'lanish | backend joyi va output nomiga | tag/parametr kontraktiga |
| Backend ko'chsa | iste'molchilar buziladi | ta'sir yo'q |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Output nomini o'zgartirish — boshqa jamoaning plan'i jimgina buziladi.
- Tag kontrakti yozilmagan — kimdir tag'ni o'zgartiradi.
- Producer apply qilmaguncha consumer eski qiymatni ko'radi — tartib kelishuvi kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Jamoalar orasidagi bog'lanish — API kontrakti kabi: aniq, hujjatlangan, minimal. SSM parametr yoki tag kontrakti eng kam ruxsat va eng kam bog'lanish beradi.

33437.a:
**Tartib:**
1. Hamma apply'larni to'xtatish, lock bor-yo'qligini ko'rish.
2. `terraform state pull > before.tfstate` — backup.
3. `terraform plan` — qaysi resurslar "create" deb chiqyapti (o'chganlar).
4. Stateful resurslar: RDS — oxirgi automated snapshot / final snapshot; S3 — versioning bo'lsa delete marker'larni olib tashlash.
5. `terraform apply` — qolganini qayta yaratish; DB snapshot'dan tiklansa `snapshot_identifier` yoki `import`.

**Oldini olish:**
- `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }` DB, bucket, KMS key uchun.
- RDS `deletion_protection = true`, `skip_final_snapshot = false`.
- Odamlarda prod/staging'da write huquqi yo'q; destroy faqat approval bilan pipeline'da.
- S3 versioning va backup'lar boshqa akkauntda.

33438.a:
**Qisqa javob:** State ichida DB parollari, access key'lar, TLS kalitlari ochiq turadi — shuning uchun birinchi qadam **barcha secret'larni rotate qilish**, keyin tarixdan o'chirish, remote shifrlangan backend'ga ko'chish va qayta takrorlanmaslik choralarini ko'rish.

**Tartib:**
```
1. state'dagi secret'larni aniqlash (jq bilan)
2. ROTATE: DB parol, IAM key, TLS, API token
3. audit: kim ko'rdi/ishlatdi (repo access log, CloudTrail)
4. tarixdan o'chirish + force push + re-clone
5. remote backend (S3 + KMS + versioning + IAM)
6. .gitignore + pre-commit scan
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# 1. nima oqib ketdi
jq '.resources[].instances[].attributes
    | to_entries[] | select(.key|test("password|secret|key|token";"i"))' terraform.tfstate

# 2. rotate (misol)
aws rds modify-db-instance --db-instance-identifier prod-db \
  --master-user-password "$(openssl rand -base64 32)" --apply-immediately

# 4. tarixdan o'chirish
git filter-repo --path terraform.tfstate --path terraform.tfstate.backup --invert-paths
git push --force --all && git push --force --tags
```
```gitignore
*.tfstate
*.tfstate.*
.terraform/
*.tfvars
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat tarixni tozalash — fork, clone, CI cache'da nusxa qoladi. Rotate'siz incident yopilmaydi.
- Private repo "xavfsiz" deb hisoblash — kirish huquqi bo'lgan hamma ko'rgan deb hisoblang.
- `sensitive = true` himoya qildi deb o'ylash — state'da baribir ochiq.

**Senior nuqta:** Ildiz sababi — lokal state. Remote backend'ni loyiha boshidan majburiy qiling (bootstrap modul) va secret'larni state'ga umuman tushirmaslik usullarini (managed password, ephemeral) qo'llang.

33439.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Backend blokini qo'shib/o'zgartirib `terraform init -migrate-state` qilasiz — Terraform eski state'ni yangi backend'ga **ko'chiradi**. `-reconfigure` esa eski state'ni e'tiborsiz qoldirib, yangi backend'ni noldan ishlatadi (ko'chirmaydi). Noto'g'ri tanlov — bo'sh state va "hammasini yaratish" plan'i.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
-migrate-state:  local terraform.tfstate --copy--> s3://acme-tf-state/api/prod.tfstate
-reconfigure:    local state e'tiborsiz,  s3 (bo'sh) -> plan: 40 to add!  (xavfli)
```

**Amalda:**
```hcl
terraform {
  backend "s3" {
    bucket       = "acme-tf-state"
    key          = "api/prod.tfstate"
    region       = "eu-central-1"
    encrypt      = true
    use_lockfile = true
  }
}
```
```bash
terraform state pull > local-backup.tfstate      # 1. nusxa
terraform init -migrate-state                    # 2. "Do you want to copy existing state?" -> yes
terraform plan                                   # 3. "No changes" bo'lishi SHART
aws s3 ls s3://acme-tf-state/api/                # 4. state joyida
rm terraform.tfstate terraform.tfstate.backup    # 5. lokal nusxalarni xavfsiz o'chirish
```

| Flag | Qachon |
|---|---|
| `-migrate-state` | state'ni bir backend'dan boshqasiga ko'chirish |
| `-reconfigure` | backend sozlamasi o'zgardi, lekin state allaqachon u yerda (masalan, CI'da yangi credential) |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Migratsiyadan keyin plan'da `+` lar — state ko'chmagan; apply qilmang, backup'dan tiklang.
- Migratsiya paytida boshqa kimdir eski backend'ga apply qiladi — jamoani ogohlantiring, apply'larni to'xtating.
- S3 bucket'ning o'zini shu konfiguratsiya bilan yaratish — "tovuq va tuxum"; bucket'ni alohida bootstrap stack'da yarating.

**Senior nuqta:** Backend migratsiyasi — kichik maintenance oynasi bilan rejalashtiriladigan operatsiya: freeze, backup, migrate, "No changes" plan bilan tekshirish, keyin freeze'ni ochish.

33441.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `block`/`rescue`/`always` — try/catch/finally: `block` dagi task yiqilsa `rescue` ishlaydi (masalan, rollback), `always` har doim (tozalash). `ignore_errors` — xatoni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi (kam ishlating); `failed_when`/`changed_when` — modulning muvaffaqiyat/o'zgarish mezonini o'zingiz belgilaysiz.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
block:  unarchive -> restart -> health check
           | xato
           v
rescue: symlink'ni prev'ga -> restart -> fail (play qizil bo'lsin)
always: tmp faylni o'chirish (har holda)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
- block:
    - name: Yangi versiyani o'rnatish
      ansible.builtin.unarchive: { src: "app-{{ ver }}.tgz", dest: "/opt/app/releases/{{ ver }}", remote_src: true }
    - ansible.builtin.file: { src: "/opt/app/releases/{{ ver }}", dest: /opt/app/current, state: link }
    - ansible.builtin.systemd: { name: app, state: restarted }
    - ansible.builtin.uri: { url: http://localhost:8080/health }
      register: h
      until: h.status == 200
      retries: 5
      delay: 3
  rescue:
    - name: Oldingi versiyaga qaytish
      ansible.builtin.file: { src: /opt/app/releases/prev, dest: /opt/app/current, state: link }
    - ansible.builtin.systemd: { name: app, state: restarted }
    - ansible.builtin.fail: { msg: "Deploy fail, rollback qilindi: {{ ansible_failed_result.msg | default('') }}" }
  always:
    - ansible.builtin.file: { path: /tmp/app.tgz, state: absent }

- name: grep "topilmadi" xato emas
  ansible.builtin.command: grep -q feature_x /etc/app.conf
  register: g
  failed_when: g.rc not in [0, 1]
  changed_when: false
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `rescue` ichida `fail` bo'lmasa — play "muvaffaqiyatli" tugaydi, CI yashil, lekin deploy aslida yiqilgan.
- `ignore_errors: true` — xatoni yashiradi, keyingi task'lar buzuq holat ustida ishlaydi.
- `rescue` faqat task xatolarini ushlaydi — host unreachable yoki sintaksis xatolarini emas.

**Senior nuqta:** Rollback mantiqi `rescue` da bo'lsa ham, haqiqiy xavfsizlik — `serial` + `max_fail_percentage`: birinchi batch yiqilsa, qolgan serverlarga umuman tegilmaydi.

33442.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `--limit` — qaysi **hostlar**da ishlashni cheklaydi; `--tags`/`--skip-tags` — qaysi **task**lar ishlashini tanlaydi; `--start-at-task` — playbook'ni ma'lum task'dan boshlaydi (yiqilgan joydan davom ettirish). Birga ular katta playbook'ning kichik qismini xavfsiz ishlatish imkonini beradi.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
- name: nginx config
  ansible.builtin.template: { src: nginx.conf.j2, dest: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf }
  notify: reload nginx
  tags: [nginx, config]

- name: facts kerak
  ansible.builtin.setup:
  tags: [always]        # har doim ishlaydi

- name: DB'ni tozalash
  ansible.builtin.command: /opt/app/bin/wipe
  tags: [never, wipe]   # faqat --tags wipe bilan
```
```bash
ansible-playbook site.yml --list-tasks --tags nginx     # avval nima ishlashini ko'ring
ansible-playbook site.yml --list-hosts --limit 'web:&prod'
ansible-playbook site.yml --tags config --limit web1 --check --diff
ansible-playbook site.yml --skip-tags slow
ansible-playbook site.yml --start-at-task "nginx config"
ansible-playbook site.yml --limit @site.retry          # yiqilgan hostlar (retry_files_enabled bo'lsa)
```
Limit naqshlari: `web1,web2`, `web:!web3` (istisno), `web:&prod` (kesishma), `'web[0:4]'`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Tag bilan ishlaganda o'tkazib yuborilgan task'dagi `register` yoki `set_fact` qiymati yo'q — keyingi task undefined xatosi bilan yiqiladi.
- `import_tasks` ga tag ichidagi hamma task'ga tarqaladi, `include_tasks` ga tag faqat include'ning o'ziga — ichidagi task'lar ishlamaydi.
- `--start-at-task` dan oldingi task'lar o'rnatgan o'zgaruvchilar yo'q.

**Senior nuqta:** Prod'da avval `--list-tasks`/`--list-hosts` bilan qamrovni tasdiqlash odati — "faqat bitta serverda deb o'ylagan edim" turidagi incidentlarni oldini oladi.

33443.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `async: N` — task'ni hostda fon jarayon sifatida ishga tushiradi va maksimal N soniya yashashiga ruxsat beradi; `poll: 0` — Ansible kutmaydi, keyingi task'larga o'tadi ("fire and forget"); keyin `async_status` bilan natija tekshiriladi. SSH ulanishi butun vaqt ochiq turmaydi — timeout muammosi yo'qoladi.

**Muammo:**
```
command: backup.sh (40 daqiqa)
SSH sessiya -> NAT/firewall idle timeout (15 daq) -> uzildi -> task "failed", backup holati noma'lum
```

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
poll: 0   -> hostda fon jarayon (job id) -> Ansible darhol davom etadi
...boshqa task'lar...
async_status (jid) -> har 30s qisqa SSH tekshiruv -> finished?
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
- name: Katta backup
  ansible.builtin.command: /usr/local/bin/backup.sh
  async: 3600        # 1 soatgacha ishlashga ruxsat
  poll: 0            # kutmaydi
  register: job

- name: Boshqa ishlar parallel
  ansible.builtin.debug: { msg: "parallel" }

- name: Backup tugashini kutish
  ansible.builtin.async_status: { jid: "{{ job.ansible_job_id }}" }
  register: r
  until: r.finished
  retries: 120
  delay: 30
```
Oddiy variant — `poll: 30`: Ansible kutadi, lekin har 30 soniyada yangi qisqa ulanish bilan tekshiradi.

| Rejim | Xatti-harakat |
|---|---|
| `async` yo'q | SSH butun vaqt ochiq |
| `async: 3600, poll: 30` | kutadi, qisqa so'rovlar bilan |
| `async: 3600, poll: 0` | kutmaydi, keyin `async_status` |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `async` vaqti tugasa jarayon o'ldiriladi — zaxira bilan qo'ying.
- `poll: 0` va `async_status` siz — natija hech qachon tekshirilmaydi, xato yashirinadi.
- `async` ni `become` bilan ishlatganda `async_status` ham bir xil `become` bilan bo'lishi kerak (job fayli boshqa user'da).

**Senior nuqta:** `poll: 0` ko'p hostda uzoq ishni parallel boshlash uchun ham kuchli. Lekin juda uzoq ishlar (backup) uchun Ansible'dan ko'ra systemd timer/cron yoki job scheduler to'g'riroq joy bo'lishi mumkin.

33444.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Sync wave — ArgoCD resurslarni belgilangan tartibda qo'llashini ta'minlaydi (`argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "-1"` avval). Sync hook (`PreSync`, `Sync`, `PostSync`) — sync jarayonining ma'lum nuqtasida Job ishga tushirish (masalan migratsiya PreSync'da). Resurslar orasida qat'iy tartib yoki bir martalik ish kerak bo'lganda.

**Muammo:** CRD'dan oldin uni ishlatadigan resurs qo'llansa — xato; yoki migratsiya pod'lardan keyin ishlasa — yangi kod eski sxemani ko'radi. Wave/hook bu tartibni boshqaradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```yaml
metadata:
  annotations:
    argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "-1"      # Secret, CRD avval
---
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: db-migrate
  annotations:
    argocd.argoproj.io/hook: PreSync
    argocd.argoproj.io/hook-delete-policy: BeforeHookCreation
```
Tartib: `PreSync hooks → wave -1 → wave 0 → wave 1 … → PostSync`. Har wave Healthy bo'lishini kutadi.

**Amalda:**
```sh
argocd app sync myapp
argocd app get myapp     # qaysi wave/hook qanday tugaganini ko'r
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Hook Job fail bo'lsa sync to'xtaydi — migratsiya backward-compatible bo'lsin.
- Wave orasida resurs Healthy bo'lmasa (noto'g'ri readiness) — sync osilib qoladi.
- Helm `pre-upgrade` hook'lari ArgoCD'da PreSync'ga aylanadi — xulq o'zgaradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Wave/hook'ni minimal ishlat — ko'p wave = sekin, mo'rt sync. Ko'pincha to'g'ri readiness probe + backward-compatible migratsiya wave'siz ham ishlaydi. Tartibga tayangan dizayn eng oxirgi chora.

33445.a:

apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout

33446.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Conventional Commits** — commit xabarlari uchun format (`type(scope): tavsif`): `fix` -> patch, `feat` -> minor, `!` yoki `BREAKING CHANGE:` -> major. Vositalar shu xabarlarni o'qib keyingi **SemVer versiyani**, **CHANGELOG** ni va Git tag/release'ni avtomatik yaratadi: **semantic-release** — har merge'da darhol, **release-please** — "Release PR" orqali.

**Muammo:** "Keyingi versiya 1.5.0 mi 2.0.0 mi?" — har safar qo'lda o'ylash, changelog yozilmay qoladi, breaking change foydalanuvchilarga kutilmaganda tegadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
fix(api): timeout 30s ga                -> 1.4.0 -> 1.4.1
feat(auth): OIDC login                   -> 1.4.1 -> 1.5.0
feat!: v1 endpoint'lar o'chirildi        -> 1.5.0 -> 2.0.0
chore/docs/test                          -> versiya o'zgarmaydi

release-please:
 merge'lar -> bot "Release PR" ni yangilab boradi (CHANGELOG + versiya)
 Release PR merge -> tag v1.5.0 + GitHub Release
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# .github/workflows/release.yml
on: { push: { branches: [main] } }
permissions: { contents: write, pull-requests: write }
jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: googleapis/release-please-action@v4
        with: { release-type: go }
```
Formatni majburlash:
```bash
npm i -D @commitlint/cli @commitlint/config-conventional
echo "export default { extends: ['@commitlint/config-conventional'] }" > commitlint.config.js
npx commitlint --from origin/main --to HEAD
```

| Vosita | Yondashuv |
|---|---|
| semantic-release | har merge = release (to'liq avtomat) |
| release-please | Release PR — qachon chiqarishni odam hal qiladi |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Squash merge'da commit xabari = PR sarlavhasi — PR sarlavhasini ham lint qil.
- `feat` ni noto'g'ri ishlatish — keraksiz minor versiyalar.
- Monorepo'da paketlar alohida versiyalanmasa — hammasi birga ko'tariladi (release-please manifest rejimi bor).

**Senior nuqta:** Avtomatik versiyalash faqat commit intizomi bilan ishlaydi; asl qiymati — foydalanuvchiga breaking change'ni ishonchli signal qilish. Ichki servislar uchun ko'pincha SemVer emas, commit SHA yetarli.

33447.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Renovate va Dependabot — repo'dagi dependency'larni kuzatib, yangi versiya chiqsa avtomatik **PR ochadigan botlar**. Xavfsiz avtomatlashtirish: yaxshi test qamrovi, **guruhlash** va **jadval** (PR shovqini kamayadi), patch/minor uchun **automerge** faqat CI yashil bo'lsa, major — qo'lda review, Docker image'larni **digest**'ga pin.

**Muammo:** Dependency'lar yillab yangilanmaydi — keyin bir kunda 3 major versiya sakrash kerak bo'ladi va CVE patch'lari kechikadi. Qo'lda kuzatish imkonsiz.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
bot (har kuni/hafta) -> manifest'larni o'qiydi (go.mod, package.json, Dockerfile, Helm, Terraform)
   -> yangi versiya -> branch + PR (changelog, release notes bilan)
   -> CI ishlaydi
   -> patch/minor + yashil -> automerge
   -> major -> label "needs-review"
```

**Amalda (`renovate.json`):**
```json
{
  "extends": ["config:recommended"],
  "schedule": ["before 6am on monday"],
  "prConcurrentLimit": 5,
  "packageRules": [
    { "matchUpdateTypes": ["patch", "minor"], "matchCurrentVersion": "!/^0/", "automerge": true },
    { "matchManagers": ["dockerfile"], "pinDigests": true },
    { "matchPackageNames": ["/^@aws-sdk//"], "groupName": "aws sdk" },
    { "matchUpdateTypes": ["major"], "labels": ["needs-review"] }
  ],
  "vulnerabilityAlerts": { "labels": ["security"], "schedule": ["at any time"] }
}
```
Dependabot (`.github/dependabot.yml`) oddiyroq: `package-ecosystem`, `schedule`, `groups`.

| | Dependabot | Renovate |
|---|---|---|
| Ekotizimlar | asosiylar | juda keng (Helm, Terraform, K8s image'lar, regex) |
| Guruhlash/jadval | bor (oddiyroq) | juda moslashuvchan |
| Platforma | GitHub | GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, self-hosted |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Testlar zaif + automerge = avtomatik prod buzilishi.
- `0.x` versiyalarda minor ham breaking bo'lishi mumkin.
- Har paketga alohida PR — jamoa e'tiborsiz qoldiradi (PR charchoq).
- Yangi chiqqan versiyani darhol olish — `minimumReleaseAge` (masalan 3 kun) supply chain hujumlaridan himoya qiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Maqsad — "kichik va tez-tez" yangilash, shunda har biri xavfsiz. Xavfsizlik PR'lari jadvaldan tashqarida darhol ochilsin.

33448.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Preview (ephemeral) environment — har PR uchun avtomatik yaratiladigan **vaqtinchalik to'liq muhit** (o'z URL'i bilan), PR yopilganda avtomatik o'chiriladi. Reviewer, QA va product o'zgarishni merge'dan oldin haqiqiy ishlayotgan holda ko'radi.

**Muammo:** Bitta umumiy staging — hamma bir vaqtda deploy qiladi, bir-birining ishini buzadi, "staging'da kimning versiyasi?" degan savol. Har PR'ga alohida muhit bu navbatni yo'qotadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
PR #123 ochildi
  -> CI: image build (tag = commit sha)
  -> helm upgrade --install pr-123 -n pr-123 --create-namespace
  -> URL: pr-123.preview.acme.uz (wildcard DNS + wildcard cert)
  -> PR'ga izoh: "Preview: https://pr-123.preview.acme.uz"
PR yopildi / TTL tugadi
  -> helm uninstall + kubectl delete ns pr-123
```

**Amalda (GitHub Actions):**
```yaml
on:
  pull_request: { types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, closed] }
jobs:
  preview:
    if: github.event.action != 'closed'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: |
          helm upgrade --install pr-${{ github.event.number }} ./chart \
            -n pr-${{ github.event.number }} --create-namespace \
            --set image.tag=${{ github.sha }} \
            --set ingress.host=pr-${{ github.event.number }}.preview.acme.uz
  cleanup:
    if: github.event.action == 'closed'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: kubectl delete ns pr-${{ github.event.number }} --ignore-not-found
```
Boshqa vositalar: Argo CD ApplicationSet (Pull Request generator), GitLab Review Apps, Vercel/Netlify (frontend).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Tozalash yo'q — klaster unutilgan muhitlar bilan to'ladi; TTL va tungi "garbage collector" job.
- DB: har PR'ga kichik seed'langan Postgres yoki umumiy DB'da alohida schema; prod ma'lumot emas.
- Tashqi integratsiyalar (to'lov, SMS) — mock yoki sandbox.
- Prod secret'lari preview'da — hech qachon.

**Senior nuqta:** Preview muhitlar narxini nazorat qil: spot node'lar, `requests` kichik, ishlatilmasa scale-to-zero. Fork PR'lar uchun avtomatik preview — xavfsizlik riski (ishonchsiz kod sizning klasteringizda).

33449.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Instant vector** — har series'ning bitta (joriy) qiymati, grafik va alert shu bilan ishlaydi. **Range vector** — har series uchun oraliqdagi nuqtalar to'plami (`[5m]`), uni faqat funksiyaga (`rate`, `increase`) berish mumkin. `rate()` — sekundiga tezlik; `increase()` — oraliqdagi umumiy o'sish (`rate * oraliq soniyalari`).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
http_requests_total          -> instant: {pod=a} 1500, {pod=b} 900
http_requests_total[5m]      -> range:   {pod=a} [1420,1440,...,1500] (20 nuqta)
rate(...[5m])                -> instant: {pod=a} 0.27 req/s
increase(...[1h])            -> instant: {pod=a} 972 so'rov
```

**Amalda:**
```promql
http_requests_total                       # instant vector
http_requests_total[5m]                   # range vector (Table ko'rinishida)
rate(http_requests_total[5m])             # dashboard throughput
increase(http_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[24h])   # "bugun nechta xato"
sum(increase(orders_created_total[1d]))   # kunlik buyurtmalar
```

| Savol | Funksiya |
|---|---|
| Hozir sekundiga nechta? | `rate` |
| Oxirgi soatda nechta? | `increase` |
| Gauge qanchaga o'zgardi? | `delta` |
| Gauge o'sish tezligi? | `deriv` |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Range vector'ni grafikka chizishga urinish — "range vector must be wrapped" xatosi.
- `increase` natijasi kasr (972.4) — oraliq chegaralarida ekstrapolyatsiya, bu normal; aniq hisob (billing) uchun metrika emas, log/DB.
- `increase` ni counter bo'lmagan metrikaga qo'llash.

**Senior nuqta:** Prometheus — taxminiy, operatsion signal uchun. Aniq biznes hisobi (to'lovlar soni) kerak bo'lsa, manba — ma'lumotlar bazasi, metrika esa trend va alert uchun.

33451.a:
```promql
# CPU: limit'dan foiz
sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!=""}[5m]))
/
sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="cpu"}) * 100

# Memory: limit'dan foiz (OOM'ga yaqinlik)
sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!=""})
/
sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory"}) * 100

# CPU throttling ulushi
rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total[5m])
/ rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total[5m])
```

Gotcha: `container!=""` (pod-level yig'indini chiqarib tashlaydi, aks holda ikki marta hisoblanadi). `container_memory_usage_bytes` page cache'ni ham o'z ichiga oladi — OOM uchun `working_set`.

33452.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Monitoring konfiguratsiyasini ham kod kabi boshqarish: Git + PR, CI'da `promtool`/`amtool` bilan validatsiya va unit test, routing testlari, bosqichma-bosqich rollout va **Watchdog** (dead man's switch) — alert yo'li butunlay ishlamay qolsa, tashqi servis buni aniqlaydi.

**Muammo:** Kimdir `alertmanager.yml` dagi route'ni o'zgartirdi, `severity=page` endi hech qayerga bormaydi. Prod yiqildi — jimlik. Jimlik "hammasi yaxshi" deb tushunildi.

**Qanday ishlaydi (watchdog):**
```
Prometheus: Watchdog (vector(1), doim firing)
   -> Alertmanager -> har 1 daqiqada heartbeat -> Healthchecks.io / PagerDuty
heartbeat to'xtadi (Prometheus, AM yoki routing buzildi) -> tashqi servis: "monitoring o'lgan!"
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
promtool check config prometheus.yml
promtool check rules rules/*.yml
promtool test rules tests/*.yml
amtool check-config alertmanager.yml
amtool config routes test --config.file=alertmanager.yml severity=page team=payments
# -> pagerduty-payments   (kutilgan receiver)
```
```yaml
# tests/api_test.yml
rule_files: [../rules/api.yml]
tests:
  - interval: 1m
    input_series:
      - series: 'http_requests_total{code="500",service="api"}'
        values: '0+10x20'
      - series: 'http_requests_total{code="200",service="api"}'
        values: '0+10x20'
    alert_rule_test:
      - eval_time: 15m
        alertname: HighErrorRate
        exp_alerts:
          - exp_labels: { severity: page, team: payments, service: api }
```
```yaml
- alert: Watchdog
  expr: vector(1)
  labels: { severity: none }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat sintaksis tekshiruvi — mantiqiy xato (noto'g'ri matcher) o'tib ketadi; routing test kerak.
- Watchdog'ni o'sha Alertmanager orqali Slack'ga yuborish — Alertmanager o'lsa, xabar ham yo'q. Tashqi heartbeat kerak.
- Config reload xato bo'lsa, Alertmanager eski config bilan ishlashda davom etadi — `alertmanager_config_last_reload_successful == 0` alert'i.

**Senior nuqta:** "Monitoring'ni kim monitoring qiladi?" — har observability tizimining dizayn savoli. Mustaqil failure domain'dagi tashqi heartbeat — eng arzon sug'urta.

33453.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Darhol: node'da diskni nima egallaganini aniqlang (`/var/log/pods`, `/var/lib/containerd`), aybdor pod'ni toping (haddan ortiq log yozayotgan), uni to'xtating/log level'ni pasaytiring. Doimiy: kubelet log rotation (`containerLogMaxSize`, `containerLogMaxFiles`), ilova log hajmini nazorat qilish, image GC threshold'lari, ephemeral-storage request/limit.

**Muammo:** bitta ilova DEBUG log'da sekundiga 10 000 qator yozdi, node diski to'ldi -> `DiskPressure` -> kubelet pod'larni evict qila boshladi, shu node'dagi boshqa sog'lom servislar ham chiqib ketdi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
container stdout/stderr -> containerd -> /var/log/pods/<ns>_<pod>_<uid>/<c>/0.log
kubelet rotation: containerLogMaxSize (default 10Mi) x containerLogMaxFiles (5)
nodefs.available < 10% -> DiskPressure -> image GC + eviction
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl describe node worker-3 | grep -i pressure
kubectl debug node/worker-3 -it --image=ubuntu -- chroot /host bash
  df -h /var
  du -sh /var/log/pods/* | sort -h | tail
  du -sh /var/lib/containerd
  crictl rmi --prune               # ishlatilmagan image'lar
kubectl logs api-x --since=1m | wc -l     # log tezligi
```
```yaml
# KubeletConfiguration
containerLogMaxSize: 50Mi
containerLogMaxFiles: 3
imageGCHighThresholdPercent: 80
imageGCLowThresholdPercent: 70
---
# pod
resources:
  requests: { ephemeral-storage: 1Gi }
  limits:   { ephemeral-storage: 4Gi }     # oshsa pod o'zi evict bo'ladi, qo'shnilar emas
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ilova faylga (`/app/logs`) yozsa — kubelet rotation qamrab olmaydi; stdout'ga yozing.
- Log fayllarni qo'lda `rm` — ochiq file descriptor bo'lsa joy bo'shamaydi; `truncate -s 0` yoki container'ni restart.
- emptyDir'ga `sizeLimit` yo'q — u ham node diskini yeydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Log hajmi — biznes metrikasi kabi kuzatilsin: namespace bo'yicha log bayt/sekund, va log pipeline'da rate limit (Fluent Bit `throttle`). Bitta shovqinli servis butun node'ni (va log tizimini) yiqitmasligi kerak.

33454.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Secrets Manager** — secret'lar uchun maxsus: o'rnatilgan rotation (RDS bilan integratsiya), cross-region replika, 64 KB gacha, har secret uchun to'lov. **SSM Parameter Store** — umumiy konfiguratsiya va oddiy secret'lar (`SecureString`, KMS bilan), ierarxik path'lar, standard tier bepul, lekin rotation yo'q.

**Taqqoslash:**
| | Secrets Manager | Parameter Store |
|---|---|---|
| Narx | ~$0.40/secret/oy + API | standard bepul, advanced pullik |
| Rotation | o'rnatilgan (Lambda, RDS) | yo'q |
| Hajm | 64 KB | 4 KB / 8 KB (advanced) |
| Ierarxiya | nom bo'yicha | `/app/prod/db_url`, `GetParametersByPath` |
| Cross-region replika | bor | yo'q |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws secretsmanager create-secret --name prod/db --secret-string '{"user":"app","password":"..."}'
aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id prod/db --query SecretString --output text
aws secretsmanager rotate-secret --secret-id prod/db --rotation-rules AutomaticallyAfterDays=30

aws ssm put-parameter --name /api/prod/log_level --type String --value info
aws ssm put-parameter --name /api/prod/stripe_key --type SecureString --value sk_live_...
aws ssm get-parameters-by-path --path /api/prod --with-decryption
```
K8s'ga ikkalasidan ham External Secrets Operator bilan; ECS'da task definition `secrets` maydoni orqali.

**Qaysi biri:**
- DB parollari, rotation kerak bo'lganlar — Secrets Manager.
- Feature flag, URL, log level, kam o'zgaradigan kalitlar — Parameter Store.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Har so'rovda secret'ni API'dan o'qish — narx va throttling; ilovada keshlang (TTL bilan).
- Rotation'dan keyin ilova eski parolni ushlab turadi — qayta o'qish yoki RDS Proxy kerak.
- IAM'da `ssm:GetParameter*` ni `*` resursga berish — hamma secret'larga kirish.

**Senior nuqta:** IAM'da path asosidagi ruxsat (`/api/prod/*`) — har servis faqat o'z secret'larini ko'rsin. Rotation'ni "yoqish" yetarli emas — ilova uni uzilishsiz qabul qilishini sinab ko'ring.

33455.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Tartib: 1) darhol qoidani olib tashlash (yoki Terraform apply bilan drift'ni qaytarish), 2) CloudTrail orqali kim/qachon/qaysi rol bilan ochganini aniqlash, 3) ochiq oraliqda begona kirish bo'lganini tekshirish, 4) oldini olish: SSH'ni umuman yopish (SSM Session Manager), AWS Config bilan avtomatik aniqlash va tuzatish, prod SG'larini faqat CI o'zgartirishi.

**Qanday ishlaydi (javob):**
```
aniqlash: Config rule restricted-ssh / GuardDuty / Security Hub -> alert
   -> containment: qoidani olib tashlash
   -> investigation: CloudTrail (kim), auth.log / GuardDuty (kirish bo'ldimi)
   -> recovery: shubha bo'lsa instance izolyatsiya, kalit/credential rotation
   -> prevention: SSM, SCP/IAM, avtomatik remediation, postmortem
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# 1. olib tashlash
aws ec2 revoke-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-123 \
  --protocol tcp --port 22 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0

# 2. kim ochdi
aws cloudtrail lookup-events \
  --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress \
  --start-time 2026-10-01 --query 'Events[].[EventTime,Username,CloudTrailEvent]'

# 3. kirish bo'ldimi
sudo last -i | head; sudo grep "Accepted" /var/log/auth.log
aws guardduty list-findings --detector-id $D

# 4. SSH o'rniga
aws ssm start-session --target i-0abc123
```
Avtomatik aniqlash va tuzatish:
```
AWS Config managed rule "restricted-ssh" -> NON_COMPLIANT
  -> EventBridge -> SSM Automation "AWS-DisablePublicAccessForSecurityGroup" / Lambda
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat qoidani o'chirib, investigation qilmaslik — agar kimdir kirgan bo'lsa, u ichkarida qoladi.
- Odamni ayblash — sabab jarayonda: nega prod konsolda SG'ni o'zgartirish huquqi bor edi?
- Terraform'da ham shu qoida bo'lsa — keyingi apply uni qaytadan ochadi; kodni tekshiring.

**Senior nuqta:** Eng yaxshi port — ochilmagan port: SSM Session Manager (IAM bilan, audit log bilan, 22 portsiz). Prod'da o'zgarishlar faqat IaC orqali, odamlarga read-only, guardrail'lar SCP va Config bilan.

33456.a:
**Tekshirish:**
1. CloudTrail **data events** (default o'chiq! yoqilmagan bo'lsa — S3 server access logs yoki boshqa dalil yo'q).
2. Athena bilan log so'rovi: `userIdentity.arn`, `sourceIPAddress`, `eventName`.
3. Principal kim: IAM user access key oqib ketganmi (Git, CI log)? Presigned URL tarqalganmi? `Principal: "*"` policy'mi?
4. IAM Access Analyzer — bucket tashqi akkaunt yoki public'ga ochiqmi.

**Tuzatish:** oqgan kalitni deactivate/delete, Block Public Access (akkaunt darajasida), policy'da `aws:SourceVpce` / `aws:PrincipalOrgID` sharti, SSE-KMS (kalit siyosati qo'shimcha nazorat), GuardDuty S3 protection.

**Saboq:** data events va access log'lar incident'dan **oldin** yoqilgan bo'lishi kerak.

33457.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `loop` — zamonaviy (2.5+) va tavsiya etiladigan sikl sintaksisi; `with_items` va boshqa `with_*` — eski lookup-asosli usul (hali ishlaydi, lekin yangi kodda `loop`). Siklda joriy element `{{ item }}` orqali olinadi.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
- name: Paketlar
  ansible.builtin.apt: { name: "{{ item }}", state: present }
  loop: [nginx, curl, htop]

- name: Foydalanuvchilar
  ansible.builtin.user:
    name: "{{ item.name }}"
    groups: "{{ item.groups }}"
  loop: "{{ users }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.name }}"     # chiqishda faqat nom (secret chiqmasin)

- name: Map ustida sikl
  ansible.builtin.debug: { msg: "{{ item.key }} = {{ item.value }}" }
  loop: "{{ ports | dict2items }}"

- name: Ichma-ich (product)
  ansible.builtin.debug: { msg: "{{ item.0 }} -> {{ item.1 }}" }
  loop: "{{ envs | product(regions) | list }}"
```

| Eski | Yangi |
|---|---|
| `with_items: [...]` | `loop: [...]` |
| `with_dict: "{{ d }}"` | `loop: "{{ d \| dict2items }}"` |
| `with_nested` | `loop: "{{ a \| product(b) \| list }}"` |
| `with_fileglob` | `loop: "{{ query('fileglob', '*.conf') }}"` |

**Tezroq usul:** ko'p modul ro'yxatni o'zi qabul qiladi:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.apt:
    name: [nginx, curl, htop]     # bitta apt tranzaksiyasi, siklsiz
    state: present
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `with_items` ro'yxatni avtomatik "yassilaydi" (flatten), `loop` — yo'q; ko'chirishda `| flatten(1)` kerak bo'lishi mumkin.
- Katta obyektlar siklida chiqish juda uzun va secret'lar ko'rinadi — `loop_control.label`.
- Ichma-ich role/task siklida `item` nomi to'qnashadi — `loop_var: user`.

**Senior nuqta:** 100 ta paket uchun sikl = 100 ta modul chaqiruvi; ro'yxatni to'g'ridan modulga berish ko'p hollarda o'nlab marta tezroq.

33458.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `import_tasks` — **statik**: playbook o'qilayotganda (parse) faylni joyiga qo'yadi; `include_tasks` — **dinamik**: task bajarilayotgan paytda (runtime) faylni yuklaydi. Shuning uchun `loop` va o'zgaruvchili fayl nomi faqat `include` bilan ishlaydi, `--list-tasks` va tag'larning tarqalishi esa `import` da yaxshi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
import_tasks: install.yml  -> parse paytida ichidagi task'lar playbook'ga "ko'chiriladi"
                              tag/when har bir ichki task'ga qo'llanadi
include_tasks: x.yml       -> run paytida, shu task navbati kelganda yuklanadi
                              tag/when include'ning o'ziga qo'llanadi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.import_tasks: install.yml          # statik
  tags: install                                      # ichidagi hamma task'ga

- ansible.builtin.include_tasks: "{{ ansible_facts['os_family'] | lower }}.yml"   # debian.yml / redhat.yml

- ansible.builtin.include_tasks: user.yml
  loop: "{{ users }}"
  loop_control: { loop_var: u }                      # faqat include bilan

- ansible.builtin.include_tasks:
    file: config.yml
    apply:
      tags: [config]                                 # include ichidagilarga tag
  tags: [config]
```

| | import | include |
|---|---|---|
| Qachon | parse vaqtida | run vaqtida |
| `loop` | yo'q | bor |
| `--list-tasks` da ko'rinadi | ha | yo'q |
| O'zgaruvchili fayl nomi | cheklangan | ha |
| Tag/when | ichki task'larga | include'ning o'ziga |

Role'lar uchun ham xuddi shu: `import_role` vs `include_role`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `include_tasks` ga `--tags config` — include o'zi tag'siz bo'lsa ichidagi task'lar umuman ishlamaydi; `apply: tags` kerak.
- `import_tasks` + `when` — shart har ichki task'da qayta baholanadi; birinchi task shart o'zgaruvchisini o'zgartirsa, qolganlari skip bo'lishi mumkin.
- Handler'ni `include` qilingan task orqali notify qilish nozik — handler nomlari oldindan ma'lum bo'lishi kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Default'da `import` (oldindan ma'lum, ko'rinadigan, tag'lar oson); faqat sikl yoki runtime'ga bog'liq fayl kerak bo'lsa `include`.

# ansible.cfg
[defaults]
forks = 50
gathering = smart
fact_caching = jsonfile
fact_caching_connection = /tmp/facts
[ssh_connection]
pipelining = True
ssh_args = -o ControlMaster=auto -o ControlPersist=60s
