```sh
vault secrets enable database
vault write database/config/orders plugin_name=postgresql-database-plugin \
  connection_url="postgresql://{{username}}:{{password}}@db:5432/orders" \
  allowed_roles=orders-app username=vault password=...
vault write database/roles/orders-app db_name=orders default_ttl=1h max_ttl=24h \
  creation_statements="CREATE ROLE \"{{name}}\" LOGIN PASSWORD '{{password}}' VALID UNTIL '{{expiration}}' IN ROLE app_rw;"
vault read database/creds/orders-app
```

**Migratsiya:**
1. Kod'dagi parolni env/fayldan o'qiydigan qilish (config ajratish).
2. Statik parolni Vault KV'ga, Vault Agent/ESO orqali yetkazish; eski parolni rotate.
3. Dynamic secret: app credential yangilanishini qo'llab-quvvatlashi kerak (fayl o'zgarsa connection pool'ni qayta yaratish).
4. Jadvallar egasi umumiy role (`app_rw`) — vaqtinchalik user'lar yaratgan obyektlar muammosiz.

Gotcha: Vault ishlamasa yangi credential yo'q — Vault HA va TTL'ni Vault uzilishidan uzunroq qilish.

33510.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `select`/`poll` har chaqiruvda barcha FD'larni skanerlaydi (O(n)); `epoll` kernelda tayyor FD'lar ro'yxatini saqlaydi va faqat tayyorlarini qaytaradi (O(tayyorlar)); `io_uring` — submission/completion ring buferlari orqali haqiqiy asinxron I/O (disk ham), syscall'larsiz batch. Nginx/Go bir nechta thread'da epoll event loop bilan yuz minglab ulanishni ushlaydi.

**Muammo:** "Har ulanishga bitta thread" modelida 100k ulanish = 100k thread = GB'lab stack va context switch. C10K muammosi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
select/poll:  har safar [fd1..fd100000] kernelga -> hammasini tekshir -> qaytar
epoll:        epoll_ctl(ADD fd) bir marta
              epoll_wait() -> faqat [fd17, fd9001] tayyor
io_uring:     user  --SQ ring--> kernel (read/write/accept so'rovlari)
              user <--CQ ring--  kernel (natijalar), syscall shart emas
```

| | select/poll | epoll | io_uring |
|---|---|---|---|
| Masshtab | O(n) | O(tayyor) | batch |
| FD limiti | select: 1024 | yo'q | yo'q |
| Disk I/O | ma'nosiz | ma'nosiz (fayl doim "tayyor") | haqiqiy async |
| Kim | eski kod | Nginx, Go netpoller, libuv, Redis | yangi DB/proxy |

**Amalda:**
```bash
strace -f -e trace=epoll_wait,epoll_ctl -p $(pidof nginx | cut -d' ' -f1)
ls -l /proc/<PID>/fd | grep anon_inode:\\[eventpoll\\]
sysctl kernel.io_uring_disabled     # 0/1/2 (6.6+)
```
Go: goroutine "bloklovchi" `conn.Read()` yozadi, runtime netpoller esa epoll orqali goroutine'ni park qiladi va tayyor bo'lganda uyg'otadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- epoll disk fayllari uchun ishlamaydi — shuning uchun libuv/Go disk I/O'ni thread pool'da bajaradi.
- Edge-triggered rejimda barcha ma'lumotni `EAGAIN` gacha o'qimasangiz voqeani yo'qotasiz.
- io_uring ko'p kernel zaifliklari manbai bo'lgan — Docker default seccomp va Google prod uni o'chiradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Xavfsizlik nuqtai nazaridan: konteyner workload'larida `kernel.io_uring_disabled=2` yoki seccomp bilan io_uring'ni yoping, faqat aniq foyda o'lchangan servislar uchun oching.

33511.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Dirty sahifa** — page cache'da o'zgartirilgan, lekin hali diskka yozilmagan ma'lumot. `vm.dirty_background_ratio` (default 10%) — fon flush boshlanadigan chegara; `vm.dirty_ratio` (default 20%) — ilovaning `write()` chaqiruvi **bloklanadigan** chegara. Katta RAM'da bu foizlar ulkan hajm beradi va ilova to'satdan qotadi.

**Muammo:** 256GB RAM x 20% = ~51GB dirty data. Disk 500MB/s bo'lsa uni yozish ~100 soniya. Shu paytda yozayotgan har bir thread bloklanadi — latency spike, `task blocked for more than 120 seconds`.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
dirty hajmi
  ^
  |               dirty_ratio (20%)  -> write() BLOKLANADI
  |------------------------------------
  |           dirty_background (10%) -> fon flush boshlanadi
  |------------------------------------
  |  normal yozish (faqat RAM, tez)
  +--------------------------------------> vaqt
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
grep -E 'Dirty|Writeback' /proc/meminfo
sysctl vm.dirty_ratio vm.dirty_background_ratio vm.dirty_expire_centisecs
# foiz o'rniga bayt (katta RAM uchun):
cat <<'EOF' | sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/60-dirty.conf
vm.dirty_background_bytes = 268435456
vm.dirty_bytes = 1073741824
EOF
sudo sysctl --system
```
`*_bytes` o'rnatilsa mos `*_ratio` avtomatik 0 bo'ladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Juda kichik qiymat — har yozuv sinxronga yaqin, throughput tushadi.
- Cgroup v2'da writeback cgroup bo'yicha ham cheklanadi — konteyner o'z limitida tezroq bloklanadi.
- DB'lar (Postgres checkpoint, `O_DIRECT` ishlatuvchilar) bilan birga ko'rib chiqing.

**Senior nuqta:** Maqsad — yozishni tekis qilish: kichikroq, tez-tez flush katta "bo'ron"dan yaxshi. O'zgartirishdan oldin va keyin p99 latency va `Dirty` grafigini solishtiring.

33512.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Congestion control — TCP yuborish tezligini tarmoq sig'imiga moslash algoritmi. **CUBIC** (Linux default) — **paket yo'qotishini** tiqilinch signali deb biladi: oynani kubik funksiya bo'yicha oshiradi, yo'qotishda keskin kamaytiradi. **BBR** (Google) — yo'qotishga emas, o'lchangan **bottleneck bandwidth** va **minimal RTT**ga asoslanib yuboradi. BBR ozgina yo'qotishli, uzoq masofali (yuqori RTT) yoki mobil tarmoqlarda ancha yuqori throughput va past latency beradi; CDN, video, global API server'larida yoqiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
CUBIC: oyna ^^^^ yo'qotish -> oyna /2 -> ^^^^ -> ...
       1% tasodifiy yo'qotish (Wi-Fi, uzoq yo'l) -> doim "tiqilinch" deb sekinlashadi
       bufer to'lguncha yuboradi -> bufferbloat (latency oshadi)
BBR:   o'lchaydi: max bandwidth (BtlBw), min RTT
       yuborish tezligi ~ BtlBw, uchishdagi ma'lumot ~ BtlBw x RTT
       tasodifiy yo'qotishga sezgir emas, buferni to'ldirmaydi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control             # cubic
sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_available_congestion_control
modprobe tcp_bbr
cat >> /etc/sysctl.d/90-bbr.conf <<EOF
net.core.default_qdisc=fq
net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control=bbr
EOF
sysctl --system
ss -ti dst 1.2.3.4 | grep -o -E "bbr|cubic|rtt:[^ ]+|delivery_rate [^ ]+"
iperf3 -c test-server -t 30 -C bbr                 # solishtirish
```
BBR faqat **yuboruvchi** tomonda ta'sir qiladi — ya'ni ma'lumot yuboradigan server'da yoqiladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- BBRv1 CUBIC oqimlari bilan bir kanalda adolatsiz bo'lishi mumkin (ularni siqib chiqaradi); BBRv2/v3 buni yaxshilagan, lekin mainline kernel'da asosan v1.
- Ma'lumot markazi ichida (past RTT, yo'qotishsiz) foyda kam — o'lchamasdan yoqmang.
- `fq` qdisc bilan birga tavsiya etiladi (pacing uchun; yangi kernel'larda TCP ichki pacing bor).

**Senior nuqta:** BBR — o'lchov bilan qabul qilinadigan qaror: A/B (ba'zi server'larda) p95 yuklash vaqti va retransmission'ni solishtiring. Global foydalanuvchiga katta kontent beradigan edge server'larda odatda aniq yutuq.

33513.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Azure ierarxiyasi: **Management Group** (siyosat va RBAC'ni ko'p subscription'ga meros qilib berish) -> **Subscription** (billing va kvota chegarasi, izolyatsiya birligi) -> **Resource Group** (birga yashaydigan resurslar konteyneri: birga deploy/o'chiriladi) -> **Resource** (VM, Storage Account, AKS). Hammasi bitta **Microsoft Entra ID** tenant'iga bog'langan. AWS bilan: Management Group ~ AWS Organizations OU, Subscription ~ AWS Account, Resource Group'ning aniq ekvivalenti yo'q (eng yaqini — tag'lar yoki CloudFormation stack).

**Nega muhim:** policy, RBAC va xarajat qayerda qo'llanishi shu ierarxiyaga bog'liq — yuqorida berilgan huquq pastdagi hamma narsaga meros o'tadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Entra ID tenant
  +-- Root Management Group
        +-- MG: Platform      (policy: faqat ruxsat etilgan region'lar)
        |     +-- Sub: connectivity, Sub: identity
        +-- MG: Landing Zones
              +-- Sub: prod  -> RG: rg-shop-prod -> AKS, SQL, Storage
              +-- Sub: dev   -> RG: rg-shop-dev
RBAC/Policy yuqoridan pastga meros: MG -> Sub -> RG -> Resource
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
az account management-group list -o table
az account list -o table
az group create -n rg-shop-prod -l westeurope --tags env=prod owner=team-shop
az resource list -g rg-shop-prod -o table
az group delete -n rg-shop-dev --yes --no-wait   # ichidagi HAMMA resurs o'chadi!
```

| Azure | AWS | GCP |
|---|---|---|
| Management Group | Organization OU | Folder |
| Subscription | Account | Project |
| Resource Group | (tag/stack) | (yo'q) |
| Entra ID | IAM Identity Center | Cloud Identity |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Resource Group'ni o'chirish — ichidagi barcha resurslarni o'chiradi; prod RG'larga **resource lock** (`CanNotDelete`) qo'ying.
- Owner rolini subscription yoki MG darajasida keng berish — meros orqali hamma narsaga.
- Turli umrdagi resurslarni bitta RG'ga yig'ish (masalan umumiy tarmoq + vaqtinchalik test VM).

**Senior nuqta:** Azure Landing Zone (Cloud Adoption Framework) naqshini qo'llang: platforma va ilova subscription'larini ajrating, policy'larni MG darajasida, va har muhit/jamoa uchun alohida subscription — blast radius va billing aniq bo'ladi.

33514.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **VNet** — Azure'dagi xususiy tarmoq (AWS VPC). **Subnet** — VNet ichidagi IP diapazon bo'lagi. **NSG (Network Security Group)** — subnet yoki NIC'ga biriktiriladigan **stateful** L3/L4 allow/deny qoidalar ro'yxati (prioritet raqami bilan). **Azure Firewall** — markaziy, managed, stateful firewall servisi: L3-L7, FQDN filtrlash, threat intelligence, TLS inspection (Premium), odatda hub VNet'da va trafik UDR orqali unga yo'naltiriladi.

**Nega ikkalasi:** NSG — arzon, har subnet'da mikrosegmentatsiya; Azure Firewall — markazlashgan egress nazorati (masalan "faqat `*.github.com` ga chiqish") va log'lash.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Hub VNet (10.0.0.0/16): Azure Firewall, VPN Gateway, Bastion
   ^ peering                       ^ peering
Spoke VNet prod (10.1.0.0/16)     Spoke VNet dev
   subnet-app [NSG: 443 from AppGW]  -- UDR 0.0.0.0/0 -> Firewall private IP
   subnet-db  [NSG: 1433 from subnet-app]
NSG qoidalari: prioritet 100-4096, kichik raqam birinchi; default qoidalar oxirida
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
az network vnet create -g rg-net -n vnet-prod --address-prefixes 10.1.0.0/16 \
  --subnet-name snet-app --subnet-prefixes 10.1.1.0/24
az network nsg create -g rg-net -n nsg-app
az network nsg rule create -g rg-net --nsg-name nsg-app -n allow-https \
  --priority 100 --direction Inbound --access Allow --protocol Tcp \
  --source-address-prefixes 10.1.0.0/24 --destination-port-ranges 443
az network vnet subnet update -g rg-net --vnet-name vnet-prod -n snet-app --network-security-group nsg-app
az network watcher show-next-hop ...      # trafik qayerga ketadi
az network nic list-effective-nsg ...     # amaldagi qoidalar
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Default NSG qoidasi `AllowVnetInBound` — VNet (va peering) ichidagi hamma trafik ochiq; aniq deny qoidasi kerak.
- NSG ham subnet'da, ham NIC'da — ikkalasidan o'tishi kerak; debug chalkashadi.
- RDP/SSH (3389/22) ni `Internet`ga ochish — eng ko'p uchraydigan Azure hujum nuqtasi; Azure Bastion yoki JIT VM access ishlating.
- Azure Firewall qimmat (soatlik + trafik) — kichik muhitlarga NAT Gateway + NSG yetarli bo'lishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Hub-spoke topologiya + markaziy firewall + Private Endpoint'lar (PaaS'ni public endpoint'siz) — Azure'da standart xavfsiz tarmoq naqshi. NSG flow logs / VNet flow logs'ni yoqib, qoidalarni haqiqiy trafikka asoslang.

33515.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Managed Identity — Azure resursiga (VM, App Service, Function, AKS pod) Entra ID'da avtomatik boshqariladigan identity beradi: kod secret saqlamasdan Key Vault, Storage, SQL kabi servislarga token bilan kiradi; kalit rotatsiyasini Azure o'zi qiladi. **System-assigned** — resurs bilan birga yaratiladi va birga o'chadi, faqat o'sha resursga tegishli (1:1). **User-assigned** — mustaqil Azure resursi, ko'p resursga biriktiriladi va umri ulardan alohida.

**Muammo (himoya):** connection string'dagi Storage key yoki SQL parol app sozlamalarida turibdi — sizib chiqsa muddatsiz kalit; rotatsiya qo'lda va kamdan-kam.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
App (VM/App Service) -> lokal endpoint (IMDS 169.254.169.254 yoki IDENTITY_ENDPOINT)
   -> Entra ID: shu resursning identity'si uchun token (resource=vault.azure.net)
   -> Key Vault: token + RBAC tekshiruvi -> secret
Kodda parol yo'q; DefaultAzureCredential buni avtomatik qiladi.
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
az webapp identity assign -g rg-shop -n app-shop                     # system-assigned
az identity create -g rg-shop -n id-shop-api                         # user-assigned
az vm identity assign -g rg-shop -n vm-1 --identities id-shop-api
az role assignment create --assignee <principalId> \
  --role "Key Vault Secrets User" --scope $(az keyvault show -n kv-shop --query id -o tsv)
```
```python
from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential
from azure.keyvault.secrets import SecretClient
client = SecretClient("https://kv-shop.vault.azure.net", DefaultAzureCredential())
print(client.get_secret("db-password").value)
```

| | System-assigned | User-assigned |
|---|---|---|
| Umr | resurs bilan | mustaqil |
| Ulashish | yo'q (1:1) | ko'p resurs |
| Qachon | oddiy, bitta resurs | ko'p instance, oldindan ruxsat, AKS workload identity |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Identity'ga subscription darajasida Contributor — RCE bo'lsa hujumchi butun subscription'ni boshqaradi; minimal rol va scope.
- User-assigned identity'ni ko'p servisga ulashish — biri buzilsa hammasining huquqi ketadi.
- VM ichidagi istalgan jarayon IMDS'dan token olishi mumkin — SSRF zaifligi identity'ni o'g'irlash yo'li; ilovada SSRF himoyasi.
- Rol berilgandan keyin token keshi tufayli bir necha daqiqa kechikish — "Forbidden" darhol yo'qolmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Maqsad — "secret yo'q" arxitektura: Azure ichida Managed Identity, AKS'da Workload Identity (user-assigned + federated credential), tashqi CI uchun OIDC federatsiya. Qolgan statik secret'lar Key Vault'da avtomatik rotatsiya bilan.

33516.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Azure RBAC** — **kim** **nima qila oladi**: identity (user, group, managed identity) ga scope (MG, subscription, RG, resurs) bo'yicha rol (Reader, Contributor, Owner, Key Vault Secrets User...) beriladi. **Azure Policy** — **qanday resurs** yaratilishi mumkin: kimligidan qat'i nazar resurs xususiyatlariga qoida qo'yadi (faqat `westeurope`, Storage'da public access yo'q, tag majburiy) — `Deny`, `Audit`, `Modify`, `DeployIfNotExists` effektlari bilan.

**Farqning mohiyati:** RBAC Owner ham Policy'ni buzib resurs yarata olmaydi. Masalan dasturchi RG'da Contributor (RBAC ruxsat beradi), lekin public IP'li VM yaratishga urinsa Policy rad etadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
so'rov: "rg-shop'da Storage Account yarat (allowBlobPublicAccess=true)"
  1. RBAC: foydalanuvchi Contributor? -> ha
  2. Policy: "Storage public access taqiqlangan" (Deny) -> RAD
  -> 403 RequestDisallowedByPolicy
Policy mavjud resurslarni ham baholaydi -> compliance hisobot
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
az role assignment create --assignee team-shop@acme.com --role Contributor \
  --scope /subscriptions/<id>/resourceGroups/rg-shop-prod
az role assignment list --scope /subscriptions/<id>/resourceGroups/rg-shop-prod -o table
az policy definition list --query "[?displayName=='Allowed locations'].name" -o tsv
az policy assignment create -n allowed-locations --policy <defName> \
  --scope /providers/Microsoft.Management/managementGroups/landing-zones \
  --params '{"listOfAllowedLocations":{"value":["westeurope","northeurope"]}}'
az policy state summarize --management-group landing-zones
```

| | RBAC | Policy |
|---|---|---|
| Savol | kim nima qila oladi | resurs qanday bo'lishi kerak |
| Ob'ekt | identity | resurs xususiyatlari |
| Natija | ruxsat / yo'q | deny / audit / tuzatish |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Policy'ni darhol `Deny` bilan joriy qilish — mavjud pipeline'lar sinadi; avval `Audit`, compliance'ni ko'rib, keyin `Deny`.
- Owner va "User Access Administrator" rollari o'ziga va boshqalarga huquq berishi mumkin — juda kam odamga, PIM (just-in-time) orqali.
- Classic administrator rollari va kalit asosidagi kirish (Storage account key) RBAC'ni chetlab o'tadi — `allowSharedKeyAccess=false` Policy bilan.

**Senior nuqta:** Guardrail'lar = Policy (MG darajasida, kod sifatida Git'da), huquqlar = RBAC (guruhlarga, minimal scope, PIM bilan). Ikkisi birga "self-service, lekin xavfsiz" platformani beradi.

33517.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Production AKS uchun asosiy qarorlar: **tarmoq** (Azure CNI Overlay yoki Cilium dataplane, private cluster yoki API server authorized IP'lar), **identity** (Entra ID integratsiyasi + Azure RBAC for K8s, local accounts o'chiq, Workload Identity), **node pool'lar** (alohida system va user pool, availability zones, autoscaler, spot pool kerak bo'lsa), **upgrade** (auto-upgrade channel, maintenance window, node image yangilanishi), **xavfsizlik** (Azure Policy/Gatekeeper, Defender for Containers, Key Vault CSI), **egress** (NAT Gateway yoki Azure Firewall UDR), **observability** (Container Insights / Managed Prometheus + Grafana), **SLA** (Standard tier — uptime SLA).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
AKS (Standard tier, AZ 1-2-3)
  control plane (managed, private endpoint)
  system pool: 3 x D4s (taint CriticalAddonsOnly) -> CoreDNS, metrics
  user pool:   autoscale 3-30, zone'lar bo'yicha
  identity: Entra ID guruhlari -> K8s RBAC; pod -> Workload Identity -> Key Vault/Storage
  egress: UDR -> Azure Firewall (allowlist)
  GitOps: Flux extension yoki Argo CD
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
az aks create -g rg-aks -n aks-prod --tier standard \
  --network-plugin azure --network-plugin-mode overlay --network-dataplane cilium \
  --enable-aad --enable-azure-rbac --disable-local-accounts \
  --enable-oidc-issuer --enable-workload-identity \
  --enable-private-cluster \
  --zones 1 2 3 --nodepool-name system --node-count 3 \
  --auto-upgrade-channel patch --node-os-upgrade-channel NodeImage \
  --enable-addons azure-keyvault-secrets-provider,azure-policy
az aks nodepool add -g rg-aks --cluster-name aks-prod -n apps --mode User \
  --enable-cluster-autoscaler --min-count 3 --max-count 30 --zones 1 2 3
az aks get-upgrades -g rg-aks -n aks-prod -o table
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Free tier prod'da — control plane SLA yo'q.
- Eski kubenet tarmoq rejimi — deprecated yo'nalish; yangi cluster'larda CNI Overlay.
- Hamma ilovani system pool'da ishlatish — CoreDNS va tizim pod'lari resurs talashadi.
- Public API server cheklovsiz va local admin kubeconfig yoqilgan — sizgan kubeconfig = cluster-admin.
- Subnet IP rejasi kichik (eski Azure CNI'da har pod VNet IP oladi) — IP tugaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Cluster'ni IaC (Terraform/Bicep) bilan, ilovalarni GitOps bilan boshqaring va cluster'larni almashtiriladigan qiling; upgrade'larni avval non-prod'da, maintenance window ichida avtomatlashtiring — K8s versiya support oynasi qisqa (~12 oy, LTS alohida pullik).

33518.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Zamonaviy usul — **OIDC workload identity federation**: GitHub Actions yoki Azure DevOps pipeline Azure'ga **secret'siz** kiradi. Entra ID'da app registration yoki user-assigned managed identity yaratib, unga "federated credential" qo'shasiz (masalan `repo:acme/api:environment:prod`), pipeline qisqa muddatli OIDC token'ni Azure access token'ga almashtiradi. Azure DevOps'da bu "Workload identity federation" turidagi service connection. Uzoq yashaydigan client secret yoki sertifikat — eskirgan amaliyot.

**Muammo (himoya):** service principal'ning client secret'i CI secret'larida saqlanadi, 2 yil muddatli, hech kim rotatsiya qilmaydi; sizib chiqsa (log, fork PR, buzilgan action) hujumchi subscription'ga kiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
GitHub Actions job (environment: prod)
  -> GitHub OIDC provider: JWT (sub=repo:acme/api:environment:prod, aud=api://AzureADTokenExchange)
  -> Entra ID: federated credential sub mosmi? -> qisqa access token (~1 soat)
  -> az / terraform / deploy
Secret saqlanmaydi, token faqat shu repo+environment uchun.
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: prod          # required reviewers bilan himoyalangan
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: azure/login@v2
      with:
        client-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
        tenant-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
        subscription-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
    - run: az aks get-credentials -g rg-shop-prod -n aks-prod
```
```bash
az identity federated-credential create -g rg-ci --identity-name id-gha-prod -n gha-prod \
  --issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  --subject repo:acme/api:environment:prod --audiences api://AzureADTokenExchange
az role assignment create --assignee <principalId> --role "Contributor" --scope /subscriptions/<id>/resourceGroups/rg-shop-prod
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `subject`ni keng qilish (`repo:acme/*`) — har qanday branch/PR prod'ga deploy qila oladi. Environment yoki aniq branch bilan cheklang.
- Pipeline identity'siga subscription Owner — minimal rol, minimal scope (RG).
- Azure DevOps Classic release'lar eskirgan yo'nalish — YAML pipeline'larga o'ting.
- Prod environment'da required reviewers va branch protection yo'q — har push prod'ga ketadi.

**Senior nuqta:** GitHub Actions va Azure DevOps ikkalasi ham to'liq ishlaydi; tanlov kod qayerda turishiga va tashkilot standartiga bog'liq. Muhimi — secret'siz federatsiya, environment himoyasi va GitOps (AKS uchun Flux/Argo) bilan push huquqini kamaytirish.

33519.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GCP ierarxiyasi: **Organization** (kompaniya domeni, ildiz) -> **Folder** (bo'lim/muhit bo'yicha guruhlash, ichma-ich) -> **Project** (resurslar, billing, API'lar va IAM'ning asosiy chegarasi) -> resurslar. IAM va Organization Policy yuqoridan pastga meros bo'ladi. AWS bilan: Organization ~ AWS Organization, Folder ~ OU, Project ~ Account. Asosiy servislar: Compute Engine (EC2), Cloud Storage (S3), GKE (EKS), Cloud Run (App Runner/Fargate), Cloud SQL (RDS), BigQuery (Redshift/Athena), Pub/Sub (SNS+SQS), Cloud Functions (Lambda), VPC (global!), Cloud IAM, Secret Manager, Artifact Registry.

**Nega muhim:** ruxsat va policy qayerda berilsa, pastdagi hamma narsaga tegadi; project — izolyatsiya va billing birligi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Organization: acme.com  (Org Policy: faqat EU region, tashqi IP taqiq)
  +-- Folder: prod
  |     +-- Project: shop-prod  -> GKE, Cloud SQL, GCS
  +-- Folder: nonprod
        +-- Project: shop-dev
Farq: GCP VPC — global resurs (subnet'lar region'da), AWS VPC — region'ga bog'liq.
Shared VPC: host project tarmog'ini service project'lar ishlatadi.
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
gcloud organizations list
gcloud resource-manager folders list --organization=123456789
gcloud projects list
gcloud projects create shop-dev-123 --folder=987654321
gcloud config set project shop-dev-123
gcloud services enable container.googleapis.com run.googleapis.com
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Project ID global noyob va o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi; nomlash standartini oldindan belgilang.
- API'lar har project'da alohida yoqilishi kerak — "API not enabled" xatosi.
- Org darajasida keng rol (Owner, Editor) — barcha project'larga meros.
- Billing account'ga bog'lanmagan project'da resurs yaratilmaydi; budget alert'larini project/folder bo'yicha qo'ying.

**Senior nuqta:** GCP'da project'lar arzon — har ilova va muhitga alohida project bering (blast radius, billing, IAM aniq), tarmoqni esa Shared VPC orqali markazlashtiring. Org Policy'lar bilan guardrail'larni ildizda qo'ying.

33520.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Service account (SA) — GCP'da ilova/mashina uchun identity. Eski usul — SA uchun JSON kalit fayl yaratish (muddatsiz secret, sizish xavfi). **Workload Identity Federation (WIF)** — tashqi identity provider (GitHub Actions OIDC, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, OIDC/SAML) token'ini GCP STS orqali qisqa muddatli GCP token'iga almashtiradi: kalit fayl umuman yo'q. GKE ichida esa **Workload Identity Federation for GKE** — K8s ServiceAccount to'g'ridan IAM principal sifatida.

**Muammo (himoya):** `sa-key.json` CI secret'ida, Git tarixida yoki noutbukda — sizsa muddatsiz kirish. Google ham kalit yaratishni Org Policy (`iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation`) bilan taqiqlashni tavsiya qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
GitHub Actions job -> OIDC JWT (repo, ref, environment)
  -> GCP STS: Workload Identity Pool + Provider (attribute condition: repo == acme/api)
  -> federated token
  -> (ixtiyoriy) SA impersonation -> qisqa access token (1 soat)
  -> gcloud / terraform
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
gcloud iam workload-identity-pools create github --location=global
gcloud iam workload-identity-pools providers create-oidc gh --location=global \
  --workload-identity-pool=github --issuer-uri=https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  --attribute-mapping="google.subject=assertion.sub,attribute.repository=assertion.repository" \
  --attribute-condition="assertion.repository=='acme/api' && assertion.ref=='refs/heads/main'"
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding deployer@shop.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser \
  --member="principalSet://iam.googleapis.com/projects/123/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/github/attribute.repository/acme/api"
```
```yaml
- uses: google-github-actions/auth@v2
  with:
    workload_identity_provider: projects/123/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/github/providers/gh
    service_account: deployer@shop.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `attribute-condition` yo'q yoki keng — boshqa repo/fork ham token olishi mumkin. Repo, branch, environment bilan cheklang.
- Deployer SA'ga `roles/owner` yoki `editor` — minimal rol.
- Mavjud SA kalitlarini o'chirmaslik — federatsiya qo'shildi, lekin eski kalit hali ishlaydi; `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list` bilan audit.

**Senior nuqta:** Maqsad — "SA kalitlari nolga": GCP ichida biriktirilgan SA, GKE'da Workload Identity, tashqarida WIF. Org Policy bilan kalit yaratishni taqiqlab, istisnolarni hujjatlang.

33521.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **GKE Autopilot** — Google node'larni to'liq boshqaradi: siz faqat pod'larni deploy qilasiz va pod request'lari bo'yicha to'laysiz; xavfsizlik best practice'lari majburiy (privileged pod'lar cheklangan), node'larga SSH yo'q. **Standard** — node pool'larni o'zingiz boshqarasiz (mashina turi, OS, autoscaling, DaemonSet erkinligi), node uchun to'laysiz. Autopilot — ko'p hollarda default tanlov; Standard — node darajasida nazorat kerak bo'lganda.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Autopilot:  pod (request: 500m, 1Gi) -> Google mos node'ni o'zi tanlaydi/yaratadi
            to'lov = pod request'lari (vCPU, memory, ephemeral) yig'indisi
Standard:   siz: node pool e2-standard-4 x 3..10 -> pod'lar joylanadi
            to'lov = node'lar (bo'sh joy ham), bin-packing sizning vazifangiz
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
gcloud container clusters create-auto shop-prod --region=europe-west1 \
  --release-channel=regular --enable-private-nodes
gcloud container clusters create shop-std --region=europe-west1 \
  --num-nodes=1 --machine-type=e2-standard-4 --enable-autoscaling --min-nodes=1 --max-nodes=10 \
  --workload-pool=shop.svc.id.goog --release-channel=regular
kubectl get nodes        # Autopilot'da node'lar ko'rinadi, lekin boshqarib bo'lmaydi
```

| | Autopilot | Standard |
|---|---|---|
| Node boshqaruvi | Google | siz |
| To'lov | pod request | node |
| Privileged/hostPath | cheklangan | ruxsat |
| Moslashuvchanlik | kamroq | to'liq |
| Operatsiya | kam | ko'proq |

**Qachon Standard:** maxsus kernel/OS sozlamalari, privileged DaemonSet'lar (ba'zi xavfsizlik/monitoring agentlari), juda zich bin-packing bilan narx optimizatsiyasi, maxsus GPU/TPU konfiguratsiyalari, node darajasida debug.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Autopilot'da request'lar minimal qiymatga yaxlitlanadi va request'siz pod'larga default beriladi — kichik pod'lar kutilganidan qimmat bo'lishi mumkin.
- Ba'zi uchinchi tomon tool'lar (privileged agent'lar) Autopilot'da ishlamaydi — avval moslik ro'yxatini tekshiring.
- Standard'da node auto-upgrade va PDB'larni sozlamaslik — upgrade'da downtime.

**Senior nuqta:** Autopilot "platform jamoasi ishini" Google'ga beradi — kichik/o'rta jamoalar uchun odatda arzonroq umumiy xarajat (odam vaqti hisobga olinsa). Standard'ni faqat aniq texnik yoki iqtisodiy sabab bilan tanlang.

33522.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Cloud Run — container'ni serverless tarzda ishga tushiradigan managed platforma: siz image berasiz, Google HTTP endpoint, TLS, autoscaling (0 gacha), yangilash va revision'lar bilan trafik bo'lishni o'zi boshqaradi; to'lov ishlatilgan vaqt uchun. Kubernetes (GKE) o'rniga ishlatiladi: stateless HTTP/gRPC servislar, event-driven ishlar (Cloud Run jobs, Pub/Sub/Eventarc), kichik jamoa va cluster boshqarishga resurs yo'q bo'lganda.

**Muammo:** 5 ta mikroservis uchun GKE cluster, node pool'lar, ingress, upgrade, monitoring — kichik jamoa uchun operatsion yuk mahsulotdan ko'p vaqt oladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
gcloud run deploy -> revision (o'zgarmas) -> trafik: rev-5 90% / rev-6 10%
so'rovlar ^ -> instance'lar 0 -> N (concurrency: bitta instance'ga 80 so'rov)
so'rov yo'q -> 0 instance (min-instances=0 bo'lsa) -> cold start
Ostida: Knative API, gVisor/microVM sandbox
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
gcloud run deploy api --image=europe-docker.pkg.dev/shop/app/api:1.5.0 \
  --region=europe-west1 --service-account=api-sa@shop.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --min-instances=1 --max-instances=50 --concurrency=80 --cpu=1 --memory=512Mi \
  --no-allow-unauthenticated --set-secrets=DB_PASS=db-pass:latest
gcloud run services update-traffic api --region=europe-west1 --to-revisions=api-00006=10
gcloud run services describe api --region=europe-west1
gcloud run jobs deploy migrate --image=... && gcloud run jobs execute migrate
```

| | Cloud Run | GKE |
|---|---|---|
| Operatsiya | deyarli yo'q | cluster boshqaruvi |
| Scale to zero | bor | yo'q (KEDA bilan qisman) |
| Stateful, DaemonSet, maxsus tarmoq | cheklangan | to'liq |
| Narx | ishlatilgan vaqt | node'lar doimiy |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Cold start — latency-sezgir servislarga `min-instances` qo'ying.
- Default service account (Compute Engine default) — keng Editor huquqi bo'lishi mumkin; har servisga alohida minimal SA.
- `--allow-unauthenticated` ichki servisga — internetga ochiq; ichki servislar uchun IAM invoker yoki ingress `internal`.
- Instance so'rovsiz paytda CPU cheklanadi (default) — fon ishlari uchun "CPU always allocated" yoki Cloud Run jobs.

**Senior nuqta:** Standart yo'l: avval Cloud Run, aniq ehtiyoj (stateful, maxsus tarmoq, GPU sharing, sidecar ko'p, katta masshtabda narx) paydo bo'lganda GKE. Ko'p kompaniyalarda ikkalasi birga yashaydi.

33523.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GCP IAM rollari: **basic** (Owner, Editor, Viewer — eski, juda keng, minglab ruxsatni qamraydi), **predefined** (Google tayyorlagan servisga xos: `roles/storage.objectViewer`, `roles/run.developer`), **custom** (o'zingiz tanlagan ruxsatlar to'plami). `roles/editor` xavfli, chunki deyarli barcha servislarda resurs yaratish/o'zgartirish/o'chirish huquqini beradi — ko'plab sezgir ma'lumot va hisoblash resurslariga, va ba'zi yo'llar bilan huquqni oshirishga (masalan service account sifatida ishlaydigan VM/funksiya yaratish) imkon beradi.

**Muammo (himoya):** "ishlasin" deb CI service account'iga yoki dasturchiga Editor berildi. Hisob buzilsa — hujumchi project'dagi deyarli hamma narsani o'zgartira yoki o'chira oladi, kripto-mayning VM'lari ishga tushiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Policy binding: member (user/group/SA) + role + (ixtiyoriy) condition
  scope: organization > folder > project > resurs  (meros pastga)
roles/editor           -> ~ minglab ruxsat, deyarli barcha servis
roles/storage.objectViewer -> faqat storage.objects.get/list
custom role            -> aniq ro'yxat, siz qo'llab-quvvatlaysiz
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
gcloud projects get-iam-policy shop-prod --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role=="roles/editor")'
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding shop-prod \
  --member=serviceAccount:api-sa@shop-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/storage.objectViewer \
  --condition='expression=resource.name.startsWith("projects/_/buckets/shop-assets"),title=assets-only'
gcloud iam roles create deployLimited --project=shop-prod \
  --permissions=run.services.get,run.services.update,iam.serviceAccounts.actAs
gcloud recommender recommendations list --project=shop-prod --location=global \
  --recommender=google.iam.policy.Recommender      # ishlatilmagan ruxsatlarni olib tashlash tavsiyalari
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Default Compute Engine SA ko'pincha Editor bilan yaratilgan — VM'lar va ilovalar shu bilan ishlaydi; o'chiring/almashtiring (Org Policy `iam.automaticIamGrantsForDefaultServiceAccounts`).
- `iam.serviceAccounts.actAs` va `iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` — boshqa SA nomidan ishlash; kuchli huquq, ehtiyotkorlik bilan.
- Shaxslarga to'g'ridan rol berish — guruhlarga bering, audit va ishdan ketishda oson.
- Custom role'larni ko'paytirish — yangi ruxsatlar qo'shilganda yangilash kerak; avval predefined'ni qidiring.

**Senior nuqta:** IAM Recommender va Policy Analyzer bilan "berilgan, lekin ishlatilmagan" ruxsatlarni muntazam qisqartiring; yuqori huquqlarni doimiy emas, PAM/just-in-time bilan bering. Basic rollar faqat sandbox project'larda.

33524.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Ansible** — agentsiz, **push** modeli: control node SSH/WinRM orqali buyruqlarni yuboradi; YAML playbook'lar. **Puppet** — agentli, **pull**: har node'dagi agent davriy (default 30 daq) Puppet server'dan catalog oladi va qo'llaydi; o'z deklarativ DSL'i. **Chef** — agentli, pull: chef-client Chef Infra Server'dan cookbook'larni oladi; Ruby DSL. **SaltStack** — asosan agentli (minion), master ZeroMQ orqali tez **push** (event bus) qiladi, lekin pull ham mumkin; `salt-ssh` agentsiz rejim ham bor; YAML + Jinja.

**Muammo:** 500 serverda bir xil konfiguratsiyani (paket, fayl, servis, foydalanuvchi) saqlash va qo'lda o'zgarishlarni (drift) avtomatik tuzatish kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Push (Ansible):   control --SSH--> server1..N   (siz ishga tushirganda)
Pull (Puppet/Chef): agent (har 30 daq) --> server: "menga catalog/cookbook" -> qo'llaydi
Salt:             master --ZeroMQ event bus--> minion'lar (sekundlarda minglab)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
ansible-playbook -i inventory site.yml --check --diff      # push, quruq sinov
puppet agent -t --noop                                     # pull, nima o'zgarishini ko'rish
chef-client --why-run
salt '*' state.apply nginx test=True
```

| | Ansible | Puppet | Chef | Salt |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Agent | yo'q | bor | bor | bor (salt-ssh'siz) |
| Model | push | pull | pull | push (+pull) |
| Til | YAML | Puppet DSL | Ruby DSL | YAML+Jinja |
| Drift tuzatish | ishga tushirilganda | doimiy | doimiy | jadval/reactor |
| O'rganish | oson | o'rta | qiyinroq | o'rta |

**Tuzoqlar (himoya nuqtai nazaridan ham):**
- Master/server (Puppet server, Chef server, Salt master) — barcha node'larda root huquqli buyruq bera oladigan markaz: eng qimmatli nishon. Uni izolyatsiya qiling, yangilab turing (Salt master'ning 2020 dagi CVE-2020-11651 zaifligi ommaviy buzilishlarga olib kelgan).
- Ansible control node'dagi SSH kalitlari ham xuddi shunday kuchli — himoyalang, vault bilan secret'larni shifrlang.
- 2025-2026 holati: Puppet (Perforce) va Chef (Progress) tijoriy yo'nalishga o'tgan, ochiq kodli jamoa fork'lari paydo bo'lgan (masalan OpenVox); yangi loyihalarda Ansible eng keng tarqalgan.

**Senior nuqta:** Immutable infratuzilma (image'ga pishirish, container, K8s) zamonida configuration management roli kichraydi: asosan base image qurish (Packer + Ansible) va qolgan "uy hayvoni" serverlar uchun. Tanlovni jamoa bilimi va mavjud ekotizimga qarab qiling.

33525.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Manifest** — Puppet DSL'dagi `.pp` fayl: resurslarning kerakli holati (`package`, `file`, `service`). **Module** — manifest, shablon, fayl va fact'larni qayta ishlatiladigan paketga yig'ish (`modules/nginx/manifests/init.pp`; Puppet Forge'dan olinadi). **Catalog** — server ma'lum node uchun manifest + ma'lumotlardan **kompilyatsiya** qilgan yakuniy resurslar grafi; agent shuni qo'llaydi. **Hiera** — kod va ma'lumotni ajratuvchi ierarxik key-value ombori (muhit/OS/node bo'yicha qiymatlar). **Facter** — node haqidagi fakt'larni (OS, IP, xotira, hostname) yig'adi va server'ga yuboradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
agent: Facter -> facts {os: Ubuntu 24.04, ip: 10.0.1.5, role: web}
   -> Puppet server: manifest/module + Hiera(facts bo'yicha qiymat) -> catalog kompilyatsiya
   <- catalog (faqat shu node uchun, bog'liqliklar grafi)
agent: catalog'ni qo'llaydi (faqat farq bo'lsa o'zgartiradi) -> report
Hiera ierarxiyasi: nodes/web-1.yaml > role/web.yaml > os/Ubuntu.yaml > common.yaml
```

**Amalda:**
```puppet
# modules/nginx/manifests/init.pp
class nginx (String $worker_processes = 'auto') {
  package { 'nginx': ensure => installed }
  file { '/etc/nginx/nginx.conf':
    ensure  => file,
    content => epp('nginx/nginx.conf.epp', { 'workers' => $worker_processes }),
    require => Package['nginx'],
    notify  => Service['nginx'],
  }
  service { 'nginx': ensure => running, enable => true }
}
```
```yaml
# data/role/web.yaml (Hiera)
nginx::worker_processes: '4'
```
```bash
facter os.release.full networking.ip
puppet parser validate init.pp
puppet agent -t --noop        # nima o'zgarishini ko'rish
puppet lookup nginx::worker_processes --node web-1 --explain   # qiymat qaysi qatlamdan
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Secret'larni oddiy Hiera YAML'da saqlash — Git'da ochiq; `hiera-eyaml` yoki Vault backend bilan shifrlang.
- Resurslar orasida bog'liqlik (`require`, `notify`) yozilmasa tartib kafolatlanmaydi.
- `exec` resursini ko'p ishlatish — idempotentlik yo'qoladi (`unless`/`onlyif`/`creates` qo'shing).
- Fact'lar agentdan keladi — buzilgan node soxta fact yuborib boshqa rol konfiguratsiyasini (va secret'larini) olishi mumkin; maxfiy ma'lumotni ishonchli (sertifikat nomi `trusted.certname`) fact'larga bog'lang.

**Senior nuqta:** "Roles and profiles" naqshi: module — texnologiya (nginx), profile — kompaniya konfiguratsiyasi, role — server vazifasi; ma'lumotlar Hiera'da. Bu kodni test qilinadigan (rspec-puppet, `--noop` CI'da) va qayta ishlatiladigan qiladi.

33526.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Resource** — eng kichik birlik: tizimning bir qismi kerakli holatda (`package 'nginx'`, `template`, `service`). **Recipe** — resurslar ketma-ketligi yozilgan Ruby fayl (`recipes/default.rb`). **Cookbook** — recipe'lar, attribute'lar, template, fayl va test'lar paketi (versiyalanadi). **Run-list** — node'da qaysi recipe/role'lar qaysi tartibda bajarilishi ro'yxati. **Test Kitchen** — cookbook'ni vaqtinchalik VM/container'da (Vagrant, Docker, bulut) yaratib, qo'llab, InSpec bilan tekshiradigan test vositasi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
node (chef-client) -> Chef Infra Server: "run-list'im nima?"
   run-list: role[web] -> recipe[base], recipe[nginx]
   -> cookbook'lar yuklanadi -> compile bosqichi (Ruby) -> converge (resurslar qo'llanadi)
   -> report server'ga
Test Kitchen: create -> converge -> verify (InSpec) -> destroy
```

**Amalda:**
```ruby
# cookbooks/nginx/recipes/default.rb
package 'nginx'

template '/etc/nginx/nginx.conf' do
  source 'nginx.conf.erb'
  variables(workers: node['nginx']['workers'])
  notifies :reload, 'service[nginx]', :delayed
end

service 'nginx' do
  action [:enable, :start]
end
```
```yaml
# kitchen.yml
driver: { name: dokken }
provisioner: { name: dokken }
platforms: [{ name: ubuntu-24.04 }]
suites:
- name: default
  run_list: ['recipe[nginx::default]']
  verify: { inspec_tests: ['test/integration/default'] }
```
```bash
kitchen test                      # create + converge + verify + destroy
knife node run_list add web-1 'role[web]'
chef-client --why-run             # quruq sinov
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Compile va converge bosqichlarini tushunmaslik — Ruby kodi (masalan `File.read`) resurslardan **oldin** bajariladi va hali yaratilmagan faylni topa olmaydi; `lazy` yoki `ruby_block`.
- `execute` resursini guard'siz (`not_if`/`only_if`) ishlatish — har ishga tushishda qayta bajariladi.
- Secret'lar oddiy attribute'larda — Chef Vault/encrypted data bag yoki tashqi secret manager.
- Cookbook versiyalarini pin qilmaslik (Policyfile'siz) — bog'liqlik yangilanishi prod'ni buzadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Policyfile'lar bilan cookbook bog'liqliklarini qulflang, Test Kitchen + InSpec'ni CI'da majburiy qiling. Chef'ning qiymati — Ruby kuchi; xavfi — konfiguratsiya to'liq dasturga aylanib, murakkablashishi.

33527.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Master** — markaziy boshqaruv serveri; **minion** — boshqariladigan node'dagi agent (ZeroMQ orqali master'ga doimiy ulangan, buyruqlarni real vaqtda oladi). **State** (`.sls` fayl) — node'ning kerakli holati YAML + Jinja'da (paket, fayl, servis). **Grain** — minion'ning **o'zi** haqidagi statik ma'lumot (OS, CPU, IP, rol) — Puppet fact'iga o'xshash, nishonlash uchun. **Pillar** — master'da saqlanadigan va **faqat tegishli minion'ga** yuboriladigan maxfiy/konfiguratsion ma'lumot (parollar, kalitlar, muhit sozlamalari).

**Muhim farq:** grain'lar minion'dan keladi (ishonchsiz — minion o'zgartira oladi), pillar'lar master'dan keladi (nazorat ostida). Shuning uchun secret'lar pillar'da, va pillar'ni grain asosida nishonlash xavfli.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
master (salt-master, 4505/4506) <==ZeroMQ, AES shifrlangan==> minion'lar
  top.sls: qaysi minion'ga qaysi state
  pillar/top.sls: qaysi minion'ga qaysi pillar
salt 'web*' state.apply -> minion'lar state'ni oladi, pillar va grain bilan render qiladi -> qo'llaydi
Reactor/beacon: event'larga avtomatik javob (event-driven)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# /srv/salt/nginx/init.sls
nginx:
  pkg.installed: []
  service.running:
    - enable: True
    - watch:
      - file: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:
  file.managed:
    - source: salt://nginx/nginx.conf.j2
    - template: jinja
    - context:
        workers: {{ pillar.get('nginx_workers', 'auto') }}
```
```bash
salt-key -L                         # kalitlar: qabul qilingan / kutilayotgan
salt-key -a web-1                   # minion kalitini qabul qilish (fingerprint'ni tekshirib!)
salt '*' test.ping
salt -G 'os:Ubuntu' grains.item osrelease
salt 'web-1' pillar.items
salt 'web*' state.apply nginx test=True
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `auto_accept: True` — har qanday mashina o'zini minion qilib ro'yxatdan o'tkazadi va pillar secret'larini oladi. Kalitlarni fingerprint bilan qo'lda yoki avtomatik, lekin tekshiruv bilan qabul qiling.
- Master portlari (4505/4506) internetga ochiq — 2020 yildagi CVE-2020-11651/11652 orqali minglab master buzilgan. Faqat ichki tarmoq, tez yangilash.
- Pillar'ni grain bo'yicha nishonlash (`G@role:db`) — minion grain'ini o'zgartirib boshqa rolning secret'larini olishi mumkin; minion ID bo'yicha nishonlang.
- `cmd.run`ni ko'p ishlatish — idempotentlik yo'qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Salt'ning kuchi — tezlik va event-driven avtomatlashtirish (reactor), lekin markaziy master — yuqori qiymatli nishon: uni bastion kabi qattiqlashtiring, kirishni cheklang va audit qiling.

33528.a:
**Bosqichlar:**
1. Inventar: module/cookbook'lar ro'yxati, qaysi node'larda, o'lik kod (ishlatilmaydigan) — o'chirish.
2. Golden image: Packer + Ansible bilan base image; Puppet faqat qolgan farqlarni boshqaradi.
3. Yangi servislar — container/K8s yoki immutable VM (ASG); config — env/ConfigMap/Secret store.
4. Eski node'larni rol bo'yicha almashtirish (yangilash emas): yangi image bilan yangi instance, trafikni ko'chirish, eskisini o'chirish.
5. Agent'ni o'chirish va server'ni dekommissiya.

**Xavflar:** Puppet yashirincha boshqarayotgan narsalar (cron, sysctl, sertifikat, user'lar) — avval ularni aniqlash (`puppet resource`, catalog tahlili). Drift tuzatish yo'qoladi — immutable model yoki muntazam Ansible run bilan qoplash.
